ar.name: بلاطات نجمية.
description:
بلاطات على شكل نجمة وصليب مصنَّعة بتقنيات التزجيج والبريق المعدني على التوالي. كانت تزين جدران قصر كيقباذ في بيشهير، وتعتبر نماذج نادرة من فن الخزف السلجوقي في ما يتعلق بالزخرفة والمعاني الرمزية. أُنتجت البلاطات النجمية باستخدام تقنية التزجيج، بينما استخدمت تقنية البريق المعدني في صنع البلاطات التي تأخذ شكل صليب. زخرفت البلاطات بمشاهد من الحياة اليومية للسلاطين والقصر بشكل عام، مغطية حقلاً واسعاً من الصور التشخيصية. فضلاً عن ذلك، تمَّ تصوير حيوانات طلسمية غريبة يُعتقد أنها تحمي القصر، وطرائد وحيوانات أليفة ومحلية مختلفة (مثل أبي الهول والسَّيرانة والطواويس والأسود والعقبان ذات الرأسين والطيور والثعالب والأرانب والذئاب والخيول والماعز والجمال والبط ).  
  
في قصر كيقباذ وُضعت البلاطات النجمية ذات الثمانية رؤوس إلى جانب البلاطات التي على شكل صليب لتشكل معاً لوحات كبيرة، حيث يغلب على الأولى الزخرفة التصويرية وعلى الثانية الزخرفة النباتية. أما النماذج المزججة فقد زُينت بالأسود والفيروزي والأزرق الداكن تحت تزجيج شفاف لا لون له.  
  
تبدي الزخرفة التصويرية اهتماماً جيداً بالطبيعة وخيالاً وأسلوباً واقعياً مفعمين بالحياة. فالعقبان ذات الرأسين تغطي سطح البلاطة بالكامل. رُسمت رؤوس العقبان بمنظر جانبي، وأجسامها بمنظر أمامي، وزوِّدت الأجسام بكتابات نقرأ عليها كلمات مثل ”السلطان“ و ”المعظَّم.“ هذه العقبان، التي غالباً ما تحاط بأشكال نباتية، يعتقد أنها تنطوي على مغازٍ رمزية. كما أن استخدامها في عهود مختلفة بوصفها شعاراً للنبالة أو رمزاً مقدساً يُعزى إلى ما تحمله من معانٍ مثل القوة والسلطة والروح الحارسة والنبالة والحكمة. وهذه العقبان ذات الرأسين، المرسومة على بلاط قصر كيقباذ، يعتقد أنها ترمز إلى السلطة، متمثلة على الأرجح بالسلطان، بحكم الكتابات المدونة على أجسامها.

يشتهر قصر قوباداباد، وهو أحد أهم قصور الحقبة السلجوقية في الأناضول، بالكسوة الآجّرية لجدرانه. وموضوعة اللوحات الآجرية الرئيسية، هي الحياة اليومية للسلطان، وحاشيته، مع حياة البلاط عموماً. إنها تعكس ملاحظة دقيقة للطبيعة، وخيالاً واسع المدى.
dates: في ظل حكم السلطان علاء الدين كيقباذ الأول (حكم في الفترة 616- 635 / 1220- 1237).
keywords: تزجيج؛ تقنية التزجيج؛ زخرفة تصويرية؛ عقاب ذو رأسين؛ السلطان علاء الدين كيقباذ الأول.

en.name: Star tiles.
description:
The star and cross tiles in underglaze and lustre techniques, respectively, that once decorated the walls of the Kubadabad Palace in Beyşehir are rare examples of Seljuq tile art in regards to their decoration and symbolic meanings. The star tiles were produced using the underglaze technique, while the cross tiles were produced using the lustre technique. Representing a wide range of figurative imagery, the tiles are decorated with scenes from the daily lives of the sultans and of the palace in general. In addition, talismanic fantastic animals that were believed to protect the palace, as well as various domestic animals and game (e.g. sphinxes, sirens, peacocks, lions, double-headed eagles, birds, foxes, rabbits, wolves, horses, goats, camels, and ducks) were also depicted.  
  
In the Kubadabad Palace, the eight-pointed star tiles were placed together with cruciform tiles to form large panels. While the star tiles have mostly figurative decoration, the cruciform ones generally have vegetal decoration. The underglaze painted examples are decorated in black, turquoise and dark-blue under a colourless transparent glaze.  
  
The figurative decoration shows good observation of nature, a lively imagination and a realistic style. The double-headed eagles are depicted in profile and cover the entire surface of the tile. Their bodies, in frontal view, bear cartouches with inscriptions reading 'al-sultan', 'al mu'azzam' ('the great'), etc. Generally framed with plant motifs, the double-headed eagles are thought to bear symbolic meanings. Used in various periods as both a coat of arms and a totem, the image of the double-headed eagle is ascribed many meanings such as strength, power, protective spirit, nobility, and wisdom. The double-headed eagles on the Kubadabad Palace tiles are thought to symbolise power, most likely representing the sultan with inscribed panels on their bodies.

One of the most important palaces of the Anatolian Seljuq period, the Kubadabad Palace is renowned for its wall tiles. The main theme of the tiles is the daily life of the sultan and his entourage and courtly life in general They reflect careful observation of nature and a wide-ranging imagination.
dates: During the reign of Sultan Alaaddin ('Ala al-Din) Keykubad I (r. hegira 616–35 / AD 1220–37).
keywords: Sultan Alaaddin (Ala al-Din) Keykubad I; Double-headed eagle; Figurative decoration; glaze; underglaze painting

es.name: Azulejos con forma de estrella.
description:
Estos azulejos con forma de estrella y cruz, con decoración bajo vidriado o de reflejo metálico, decoraron en tiempos las paredes del palacio de Kubadabad de Beyşehir y constituyen singulares ejemplos del arte selyuquí del azulejo desde el punto de vista de la decoración y de su simbología. Presentan una gran variedad de imágenes figurativas y reflejan escenas de la vida cotidiana de los sultanes y palaciegas en general. También se representaban animales fantásticos que, según se creía, protegían el palacio, así como diversos animales domésticos y de caza (esfinges, sirenas, pavos reales, leones, águilas bicéfalas, pájaros, zorros, conejos, lobos, caballos, cabras, camellos y patos).  
En el palacio de Kubadabad, los azulejos de estrella de ocho puntas se combinaban con azulejos en cruz para formar grandes paneles. Los azulejos de estrella tienen en su mayoría adornos figurativos, pero los cruciformes, por lo general, presentan motivos vegetales. Los azulejos con decoración bajo vidriado tienen adornos en negro, turquesa y azul oscuro bajo un vidriado translúcido e incoloro.  
La decoración figurativa demuestra una atenta observación de la naturaleza, una imaginación vívida y un estilo realista. Las águilas bicéfalas miran de perfil y cubren completamente la superficie del azulejo. Tienen el cuerpo de frente y presentan cartuchos con inscripciones como *al-sultan*, *al muazzam* ('el grande'), etc. Se cree que estas águilas bicéfalas, que suelen aparecer rodeadas de motivos vegetales, tienen contenido simbólico. Esta imagen se usó como escudo de armas y tótem en diversos periodos, y se le atribuyen varios significados como fuerza, poder, espíritu protector, nobleza y sabiduría. Se cree que las águilas bicéfalas de los azulejos del palacio Kubadabad simbolizan el poder, normalmente el del sultán, como se especifica en los bordes.

El palacio de Kubadabad, uno de los más importantes de periodo selyuquí de Anatolia, es famoso por sus murales de azulejos. El tema principal es la vida cotidiana del sultán, su séquito y la vida cortesana en general. Reflejan una atenta observación de la naturaleza y una gran imaginación.
holder: Museo de la Madrasa de Karatay.
dates: Sultanato de Alaaddin Keykubad I (r. 616-635 de la Hégira / 1220-1237 d. C.)
keywords: Sultán Alaaddin (Ala al-Din) Keykubad I; águila bicéfala; decoración figurativa; vidriado; técnica de bajo vidriado.

fr.name: Carreaux en étoile.
description:
Les carreaux en forme d'étoile ou de croix décorés en sous-glaçure ou au lustre qui ornaient jadis les murs du palais de Kubadabad à Beysehir constituent de rares exemples de l'art du carreau de céramique seldjoukide pour leur qualité décorative et leur signification symbolique. Les carreaux de forme stellaire étaient décorés sous glaçure et les cruciformes au lustre. Faisant appel à une imagerie figurative très variée, ils représentent généralement des scènes de la vie quotidienne des sultans dans leurs palais. Des animaux fabuleux talismaniques (comme sphinx, sirènes, aigles bicéphales) censés protéger le palais ainsi que divers animaux domestiques et sauvages (dont paons, lions, oiseaux, renards, lapins, loups, chevaux, chèvres, chameaux et canards) sont également reproduits.  
Dans le palais de Kubadabad, des carreaux en étoile à six branches sont associés à des modèles cruciformes pour former de grands panneaux. Si les carreaux en étoile reçoivent généralement un décor figuratif animalier, les cruciformes sont plutôt ornés d'un décor végétal. Les carreaux peints sous glaçure sont décorés en noir, turquoise et bleu foncé sous glaçure transparente incolore.  
Le décor figuratif atteste une bonne observation de la nature, un certain sens du réalisme mais aussi une grande imagination.  
Les aigles bicéphales sont représentés de profil et occupent la totalité de la surface du carreau. Leur corps, pris en vue frontale, porte des cartouches à inscriptions comme “al-sultan”, “al-mu'azzam” (le grand), etc. Généralement entourés de motifs de plantes, ils revêtaient probablement une signification symbolique. Utilisée à diverses périodes dans les armes et les totems, l'image de cet animal fabuleux peut prendre de multiples significations comme la force, le pouvoir, la protection, la noblesse et la sagesse. Les carreaux à aigles bicéphales du palais de Kubadabad qui portent les armoiries du sultan symbolisent sans doute le pouvoir de celui-ci.

Un des plus importants palais de la période des Seldjoukides d’Anatolie, le palais de Kubadabad est renommé pour ses carreaux muraux. Le thème principal en est la vie quotidienne du sultan et de son entourage, ainsi que la vie de cour. Ils dénotent une observation attentive de la nature, et une grande imagination.
keywords: glaçure ; sous-glaçure ; décoration figurative : Alaadin [Ala al-Din] Keykubad Ier, aigle bicéphale
tags: décoration figurative : Alaadin [Ala al-Din] Keykubad Ier, aigle bicéphale

tr.name: Yıldız Çiniler.
description:
Beyşehir Kubadabad Sarayı'nın duvarlarını süsleyen yıldız-haç kompozisyonlu sıraltı ve lüster teknikli çiniler, gerek desen özellikleri gerekse taşıdıkları sembolik anlamlarla, Anadolu Selçuklu çini sanatının nadir örnekleridir. Geniş bir figür dünyasının yansıtıldığı çinilerde, genel olarak sultan ve saray yaşantısı konu edilmiştir. Ayrıca, sarayı koruduğuna inanılan, tılsımlı fantastik hayvanlar ile çok çeşitli av ve evcil hayvan figürlerine de (sfenks, siren, tavus kuşu, aslan, çift başlı kartal, kuş, tilki, tavşan, kurt, at, keçi, deve, ördek vb.) yer verilmiştir.  
  
Kubadabad Sarayı örneklerinde, yıldız formlu (sekiz köşeli) çiniler, haç formlu çinilerle birbirlerine bağlanarak büyük panolar meydan getirmiştir. Yıldız çinilerde figürlü süsleme yoğunluktadır. Haç formlu çinilerde ise figürlü süslemeye daha az yer verilmiş, genel olarak bitkisel bezeme kullanılmıştır. Sıraltı tekniğinde işlenmiş örneklerde, şeffaf renksiz sıraltına, siyah, firuze ve lacivert renklerle bezeme yapılmıştır.  
  
İyi bir doğa gözlemciliği ve geniş bir hayal gücünün sonucu olarak meydana getirilen figürlü bezemelerde, gerçekçi bir üslup benimsenmiştir.  
  
Profilden verilmiş çift başlı kartallar, yıldız çinin bütün yüzeyini kaplayacak şekilde yerleştirilmişlerdir. Kartalların cepheden verilmiş gövdelerinde bir kartuş içerisinde “es-sultan” yada “el-muazzam” gibi sultanı temsil eden yazılar yer almaktadır. Genel olarak yanlardan birer bitki ile çevrelenen çift başlı kartallar, çeşitli sembolik anlamlar taşımaktadırlar.  
  
çeşitli dönemlerde arma ve totem olarak kullanılan “çift başlı kartal” figürüne; güç, iktidar, koruyucu ruh, soyluluk, bilgelik gibi bir çok anlam yüklenmiştir. Kubadabad Sarayı örneklerinde de gücü simgelediği düşünülen çift başlı kartallar, gövdelerindeki armalarla da muhtemelen Selçuklu Sultanını temsil etmektedirler.

Anadolu Selçuklu döneminin en önemli saraylarından biri olan Kubadabad Sarayı, duvarlarını süsleyen çinileriyle ünlüdür. Ana tema olarak sultan, maiyeti ve saray yaşantısının işlendiği çinilerde, iyi bir doğa gözlemciliği ve geniş bir hayal gücünün etkileri görülmektedir.
keywords: Sır; Sıraltı tekniği; Figüratif bezeme; I. Alaaddin Keykubad; Çift başlı kartal

ar.name: القصبة (القلعة).
description:
تقع القصبة (القلعة) على ارتفاع 118 متر فوق سطح البحر، عند زاوية المثلث الذي تشكله الأسوار التي تحمي مدينة الجزائر- العاصمة. تتشكل قاعدة هذا المثلث من الجبهة البحرية، وجعلت هذه المجموعة الدفاعية من "مدينة الجزائر المحروسة" قلعة، تعرف اليوم "بالقصبة".  
قد يرجع بناء القلعة إلى مابين عام 959 وعام 980 هجري / 1552 و 1572 ميلادي. أقيمت أعمال بناء باب القلعة عام 1000 هجري / 1591 ميلادي، وذلك لاستبدال الأبواب القديمة التي تبين أنه يسهل تهديمها. بعد ذلك، أمر الداي حسين ببعض الأعمال من أجل أن يقيم في القلعة ويجعل منها مركزاً لسلطته في عام 1232 هجري / 1817 ميلادي. وبالإضافة إلى الثكنات القديمة، بقي بالقلعة مسجدان وقصران ومخزن للبارود وسور وحمامات ومطابخ وملحقات متنوعة. وتشكل المجموعة، التي هي قيد الترميم، تجمعاً ضخما بفضل المساحة الشاسعة التي تحتلها. ويبقى الترتيب الزمني لتاريخ هذه الأبنية معقدا بسبب تعدد وتنوع الاستيطان بالموقع، والتغييرات التي ألحقوها بمكوناته.

تعلو القصبةُ المدينةَ القديمة للجزائر، في أقصى جنوب الأسوار التي تحميها، مما جعل المدينة تسمى "الجزائر المحروسة". يُحتمل أن يكون البابُ قد أعيد بناؤه لاحقا؛ بعد ذلك، وعلى إثر تهيئات، أصبحت القصبة، على عهد الداي حسين، مقرا للسلطة. فبالإضافة إلى حي الإنكشاريات، لازال بالقلعة قصران ومستودع للبارود، والأسوار ومسجدان وحمامات ومطابخ وملحقات.
keywords: خزف؛ عمارة بلاطية / عمارة أميرية / عمارة قصرية؛ عمارة عسكرية؛ ماء.
tags: عمارة بلاطية / عمارة أميرية / عمارة قصرية

en.name: Kasbah (citadel).
description:
The Kasbah (citadel) is situated 118 m above sea level, at the tip of the triangular arrangement formed by the ramparts that protect the *medina* of al-Djazaïr (Algiers). The sea forms the base of this triangle. This defensive construction turned the *medina* of al-Djazaïr al-Mahrussa (Algiers the well-protected) into a citadel, which was actually called 'Kasbah'.  
The construction of the citadel occurred between AH 959 and 980 / AD 1552 and 1573. Construction work involving the citadel's gate was undertaken in AH 1000 / AD 1591 to replace the old gates that were judged to be 'easier to break down'. The *dey* Husayn commissioned the building works that were necessary for his moving in, and made it the seat of his government in AH 1232 / AD 1817. In addition to the internal barracks, it contained two palaces, the powder-magazine, the ramparts, two mosques, *hammam*, kitchens and various annexes. The site, which is in the process of being restored, is impressive in terms of the surface area it occupies. The number and variety of uses to which the buildings were put, as well as the transformations that they were subjected to as a result, have made their chronological history complicated.

The citadel sits on top of the Algiers *medina* at the southern edge of the ramparts that protect it, and they are the reason the town is known as 'Algiers the well-protected'. The gateway is a later addition. Following conversion, the citadel became the seat of power under *dey* Husayn. In addition to the janissaries' quarters, two palaces, a powder store, ramparts, two mosques, the *hammam*, kitchens and annexes have survived.
dates: Between hegira 959 and 980 / AD 1552 and 1572; AH 1000 / AD 1591.
artist: Arrudj Barbarossa (also known as Barbaros Hayreddin Pasha in Turkey).
keywords: Military architecture; palatine architecture; ceramics; water

es.name: Ciudadela.
description:
La alcazaba de Argel está situada a 118 m por encima del nivel del mar, en la punta del triángulo formado por las murallas que protegían la medina de al-Yazair (Argel) y el mar en su base. El conjunto defensivo convirtió la medina de *al-Yazair al-mahrusa* (Argel la bien protegida) en una ciudadela, actualmente llamada “Casbah”.  
Su construcción debió llevarse a cabo en los años 959-980 / 1552-1573. En el año 1000 / 1592 se iniciaron los trabajos en la puerta de la Ciudadela para sustituir las antiguas puertas, consideradas “más fáciles de derribar”. En 1232 / 1817, el dey Hussayn mandó hacer obras para trasladarse a ella y convertirla en sede de su gobierno. Además de los cuarteles iniciales, perduran dos palacios, el polvorín, las murallas, dos mezquitas, un *hammam*, cocinas y diversos anexos. El conjunto, actualmente en restauración, resulta impresionante por la superficie que ocupa. La cronología histórica de los edificios es compleja, debido a los diferentes usos y a las transformaciones.

La ciudadela domina la medina de Argel desde el extremo sur de las murallas que la protegían, hecho por el cual la ciudad fue llamada “Argel la bien guardada”. Más tarde y después de una habilitación, la ciudadela se convirtió en la sede del gobierno bajo el dey Husayn. Aparte del barrio de los jenízaros, perduran dos palacios, el polvorín, las murallas, dos mezquitas, un *hammam*, cocinas y anejos.
dates: Entre 959 y 980 de la Hégira / 1552 y 1572-1573 d. C.
artist: Abu Arush ibn Yusuf Barbarroja y su hermano Jayr al-Din.

fr.name: Casbah (citadelle).
description:
La Casbah (citadelle) est située à 118 m au-dessus du niveau de la mer à la pointe du triangle formé par les remparts protégeant la médina d'Al-Djazaïr (Alger). La base de ce triangle est constituée par la mer. L'ensemble défensif fit de la médina d'*El Djazaïr El Mahroussa* (Alger la bien protégée)une citadelle,actuellement appelée “Casbah”.  
  
La construction de la Citadelle remonterait entre 959 et 980 H /1572-1573 J.-C. Des travaux de construction de la porte de la citadelle furent entrepris en 1000 H / 1591 J.-C. en remplacement des anciennes portes jugées “plus faciles à abattre”. Le dey Hussein fit faire des travaux pour s'y installer et en faire le siège de son pouvoir en 1232 H / 1817 J.-C. Outre les casernements initiaux, il subsiste deux palais, la poudrière, les remparts, deux mosquées, des hammams, des cuisines et diverses annexes. L'ensemble, actuellement en cours de restauration, est impressionnant par la surface occupée. La chronologie historique des bâtiments est complexe en raison des nombreuses et différentes occupations subies et des transformations qu'elles ont dû entraîner.

La citadelle surmonte la médina d'Alger à l'extrême sud des remparts qui la protégeaient – ce pourquoi la ville a été appelée “Alger la bien gardée”. La porte aurait été reconstruite ultérieurement. Par la suite et après aménagements, la citadelle devient le siège du pouvoir sous le dey Hussein. Outre le quartier des janissaires subsistent deux palais, la poudrière, les remparts, deux mosquées, des hammams, des cuisines et des annexes.
keywords: architecture militaire ; architecture palatine ; céramique ; eau

ar.name: برقع  (كادري)
description: هذا البرقع يعود فقط لبداية القرن العشرين وهو مطرز بأزهار وبأسماء الله ومحمد وفاطمة وحسن وحسين وكذلك عبارة الشهادة. في عام 1997 أصدرت الشرطة الدينية في أفغانستان قرارا بوجوب ارتداء كل النساء الكادري في العلن. وهذا أحدث تغيرا كبيرا في حياة النساء حيث أن النساء اللواتي لا يغطين أنفسهن بشكل لائق كن يعاقبن بشدة وكذلك أرباب أسرهن أو يمكن أن يتعرضن للضرب علنا من قبل ميليشيا طالبان. وفي أوربا اليوم فإن المطالبات المشروعة من مجتمعات المهاجرين للتمثيل المتساوي لقيمهم الدينية قد أدى  لظهور تيار معارض يقوده بشكل أساسي السياسيون المعروفون ضد المطالبات الثقافية والدينية للتعددية. وبسبب زيادة وجود الإسلام في النطاق العام فإن الكادري والأشياء الإسلامية / ملابس المرأة المسلمة لم تعد ترى كمجرد إشارات للأصل ولكنها تحولت لتصبح رموزا للإرهاب.

en.name: A *chādri* grill
description:
This grill dates from the early 20th century. It is embroidered with flowers, with the names of Allah, Muhammad, Fatima, Hasan and Husayn, and with the Muslim declaration of belief.  
In 1997, the religious police decreed all women in Afghanistan must wear the *chādri* in public. This brought about a significant change for women. Women who were improperly covered outside their home were punished severely, along with their family elders, or risked being beaten in public by Taliban militiamen. In present-day Europe, migrant communities’ legitimate demands for equal representation of their religious values and symbols has aroused a counter-discourse, mainly led by populist politicians, against the cultural and religious demands of pluralism. Due to the increasing presence of Islam in the public sphere the *chādri* and other items of Islamic/Islamist women’s clothing are no longer seen as a mere signs of subservience but have shifted to become symbols of terrorism.

description: A *Shadda* woven entirely consistently, with the motifs on the horizontal plain in the central field matching the border ornament.
dates: Date unknown, purchased by the Museum in the 19th century

materials: Wool warp and weft; plain weave

ar.name: لوحة أمامية مزينة عبارة عن سطح مرئي أعلى كبين السائق
description: تماما مثلما تعمل اللوحات المرسومة في باكستان فإن وصول عصر التصوير الفوتوغرافي والصور المنتجة بكميات كبيرة – مع توفر الطلاءات الزيتية – ساعد في تطور الفن الشعبي في النصف الثاني من القرن العشرين وأدى لرسم لوحات ضخمة ناصعة على الشاحنات البرية في أفغانستان وباكستان. وإن أجسام الشاحنات كانت ترسم بتخطيط شعري أو آيات دينية ونماذج مزهرة وحدائق الجنة ومشاهد ألبية ومواقع مقدسة وصور لأبطال بشريين وطائرات وصواريخ من قبل فناني الشوارع في مواقف الشاحنات في كل شمال غرب باكستان.

en.name: Decorated front panel of the viewing deck at the top of the driver's cab
description: Just like the Billboard painting performed in Pakistan, the advent of photography and the massproduced picture – together with the availability of oil-based paints – assisted in the development of a popular art form in the second half of the twentieth century, the brightly painted large overland lorries of Afghanistan and Pakistan. The truck bodies were painted with calligraphy of poetic or religious verses, floral patterns, gardens of paradise, alpine landscapes, holy sites, and images of human heroes, trains, planes and rockets by street artists at truck stands all across northwest Pakistan.

ar.name: مبخرة
description: هذه المبخرة المصبوبة المجوفة بشكل طائر لها ثقب  في صدر الطائر وأجنحته وحول العنق. وتوجد فتحات على العرف والرقبة والصدر والأسفل  وهذه في الطرف الأسفل صغيرة جدا ومتوضعة على كلا جانبي السطح.والعينين مرتفعتين بشكل طفيف والريش المحفور يصل إلى الكتفين ويساير نقش كوفي عبر الكتفين ويقطعه الجناحين. والتزيين بكلابات النبات المتسلق الحلزوني المثقب هو على الصدر مع وجود فتحة في الوسط . والجناحين مضلعين ولهما دورات محفورة ورصائع من كلابات النباتات المتسلقة ومركز مرتفع. والزخرفة النباتية المتسلقة ذات المحور المركزي للتناظر تسير عبر الخلف. والريش التخطيطي يغطي الجسم الباقي.وقد حشر البخور في فتحة الصدر ويمكن أن تعبق روائحه عبر السطح المثقب.
keywords: مبخرة ، برونز ، مشغولة معدنية ، مشغولة معدنية مطعمة ، إيران ، العالم الإيراني ، أفغانستان ،  بلاد فارس ، نقش ، طائر ، حيوان

en.name: Incense Burner
description:
This is a hollow cast incense burner in the shape of a bird. It is perforated in the chest, wings and around the neck. Openings are on the crest, neck, chest and underside. Those on the underside are very small and positioned at both ends of the surface.  
The eyes are slightly elevated, engraved feathers reach till the shoulders. A *kufic*\-inscription runs across the shoulders and is interrupted by the wings. A perforated spiralling tendril ornament is on the chest, with an opening in the middle. The wings are ribbed and have engraved twirls, tendril-medallions and an elevated centre. A tendril ornament with a central axis of symmetry runs across the back. Schematic feathers cover the remaining body.  
Incense was inserted into the chest opening and could escape through the heavily perforated surface.
holder: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection
keywords: Incense burner; Bronze; metalwork; Inlaid metalwork; Iran; Iranian world; Afghanistan; Persian world; Inscription; Bird; Animal
partner: University Museum of Islamic Art | The Bumiller Collection

en.name: *King Solomon’s Mines*
short_description: The book is a narrative of an expedition to East Africa, in search of gold - the King Solomon's mines; a pretext for an imaginary trip to a part of the world that at the end of the 19th century attracted travellers, scientific explorers, adventurers and travellers: the delta of the Nile in Africa.
holder: National Library of Portugal, Digital Library
artist: Author: Ryder Haggard; translator and editor: José Maria Eça de Queirós
keywords: Literature; Travel; Africa; Adventure

de.name: Hochaltar
description: Der Hochaltar, vielleicht ein Werk des Johann Georg Pauer aus Tannheim, wurde um 1710 geschaffen. Sein wuchtiger, vollständig vergoldeter Aufbau mit vortretendem Sprenggiebel über gewundenen Säulen zählt zu den bedeutendsten Leistungen des hochbarocken Altarbaus im Außerfern. Das Altarblatt des aus Pfronten im Allgäu stammenden Barockmalers Johannes Heel mit der Anbetung der Hirten, im Deckenbild durch die Anbetung der hl. Dreifaltigkeit überhöht.

en.name: High altar
description: The high altar, possibly a work of Johann Georg Pauer from Tannheim, was built around 1710. Its massive, completely gilded superstructure with projecting strutted pediment above spiral columns is one of the most important achievements of High Baroque altar-construction in Außerfern. The altarpiece from the Baroque painter Johannes Heel from Pfronten in Allgäu depicting the Adoration of the Shepherds is situated beneath the ceiling fresco of the *Adoration of the Holy Trinity*.
place: Choir, Catholic Guild Church of St. Joseph

en.name: Photograph of Bab Idris street
description: Pictured here is Bab Idris street, leading to Bab Idris, the city's western gate and the entrance to the old town. By the time of Ahmad Bey al-Jazzar's reign (1777–1804), the city had four main gates: Bab al-Dirka to the south, Bab al-Santiya to the west, Bab al-Dabbagha to the north, and Bab al-Saraya to the east. Jazzar Pasha built fortifications between these four main gates, which was not a fortified gate. Other city gates included Bab Yaqub, also in the east, Bab Abu Nasr at Burj square, and Bab Idris. These non-military gates are reflections of the city's rapid expansion, particularly due to an increase in trade.
keywords: Gate; Military; Fortified; Portal; Expansion

de.name: Inneres (Langhaus und Chor)
description: Der Raum der Klosterkirche von Rattenberg ist ein Meisterstück barocker Prospektwirkung. Die Sicht durch den breitgelagerten, drei Joche umfassenden Langhaussaal mit seinem flachen Kreuzgratgewölbe und den breiten Zwischengurten erfährt an dem stark eingezogenen Triumphbogen eine deutliche Zäsur. Die kräftige Pilasterarkade mit Halbrundbogen gibt den Blick frei in die Mitte des Chorraums, von der vom Langhaus nur die östliche, den Hochaltar einbeschreibende Arkade und ein Teil des Kuppelgewölbes mit dem Fresko sichtbar werden. Vom Langhaus erscheinen so der Hochaltar und der östliche Teil des Deckenbilds in unmittelbare Beziehung gesetzt.
artist: Unbekannter lombardischer Baumeister (erste Barockisierung des Langhauses); Diego Francesco Carlone und Paolo d’Allio (Stuckausstattung des Chors).

en.name: Interior (nave and choir)
description: The interior of the monastery church is an exquisite example of a Baroque prospect. The view through the wide, three-bayed nave hall with shallow groined vault and wide fascia experiences a decisive caesura at the retracted triumphal arch. The powerful pilaster arcade with semi-circular arches provides an unobstructed view of the centre of the choir, of which only the eastern arcade framing the high altar and part of the domical vault with the fresco is visible from the nave. Thus the high altar and the eastern section of the ceiling painting appear to be placed in direct relation to one another.
artist: Unknown Lombardian master builder; Diego Francesco Carlone (1674–1750), Paolo d’Allio (1655–1729)

en.name: Map of the Ottoman province (vilayet) of Damascus marking the Hijaz Railway line in red.
description: The map is part of the Pocket Atlas of the Ottoman Lands: The Geographical and Statistical Conditions of the Ottoman State. It depicts the territories extending from the Hama region in the north through Damascus, the Hauran, and Jordan to the northern Hijaz. A red line begins at Hama and continues southward, representing the Hijaz Railway. A western branch extends toward the Mediterranean coast, corresponding to the railway connection between the main line and Haifa. The principal heading reads سوريه ولايتى, Vilayet of Syria. The vilayet was the principal provincial administrative unit established under the Ottoman provincial reforms of the nineteenth century. Vilayets were divided into sanjaks, and beneath the title the map identifies the four sanjaks of Damascus, Hama, Hauran, and Karak.
keywords: Map; Syria; Türkiye; trainline; Hijaz

en.name: *Panorama of the Compagnie Transatlantique* (French Line). *The "La Ville de Rome" steamer leaving the port of Algiers via Montenard*
names: Taken from the Exposition Universelle of 1889
short_description: The emergence of steam boats in the 19th century allowed important maritime trade relationships to develop. In 1855, the Pereire brothers adopted this new method of transport and founded the Compagnie Générale Transatlantique (The French Line). The first line built served New York. In the 1880s the company then established an important line from Marseille to North Africa, which consisted of a 12-steamer strong fleet, the "sister ships" of the "Ville de Rome", which was first put into use in 1881. In March 1889, the "Ville de Rome" was run aground and washed up on the shores of Menorca. The passengers were evacuated in time, but the storm caused the wreck of the ship to break in two.
artist: Photographer: Neurdein Frères; artist: Frédéric Montenard
keywords: Transports; boats; ports; Algeria

fr.name: *Panorama de la Compagnie Transatlantique. Le steamer*
short_description: Au XIXe siècle, les bateaux à vapeur (steamers) vont permettre un développement important des liaisons maritimes. En France, les frères Pereire adoptent ce nouveau transport et fondent en 1855, la Compagnie Générale Transatlantique. La première ligne créée dessert New-York. Dans les années 1880, la Compagnie établit également avec l’Afrique du Nord un important trafic à partir de Marseille avec une flotte de 12 steamers, les « sister ships », dont le « Ville de Rome » mis en fonctionnement en 1881. En mars 1898, au cours d'une traversée Marseille-Alger, le « Ville de Rome » s'échoue près de Minorque. Les passagers sont évacués à temps, sous l’effet de la tempête l’épave se brisera en deux.
artist: Photographe: Neurdein frères; peintre, dessinateur: Frédéric Montenard
keywords: Transports; bateaux;ports; Algérie

description: The bowl is decorated in turquoise, blue, and purple in a opaque white glaze. The decoration in black and red is overglaze. The bowl is embellished by leaf gilding decoration.

it.name: Coppa
description: La coppa è decorata in turchese, blu e viola sotto l'invetriatura bianca opaca. La decorazione in nero e rosso  è applicata sopra l'invetraitura. La coppa è impreziosita da una decorazione a foglia d'oro.
dates: Ègira VI–VII secolo / AD XII–XIII secolo

partner: MAO Museo d'Arte Orientrale (Fondazione Torino Musei)

en.name: Chiesa dell'Assunzione
description:
The sober but elegant façade of the church overlooks a square and acts as a sort of scenographic wing for one of the main streets. It is a central plan church with an octagonal tiburium. The brickwork façade is made of two orders linked by two elegant volutes, a typical baroque feature.  
Thanks to the hemispherical apse the interior looks quite spacious and it is marked by white stucco columns; between them open small choirs with refined stucco frames.  
The altars date from the end of the eigtheenth to the beginning of the nineteenth century The apse is Neoclassic.

This church was renovated by the architect Alfonso Torreggiani. It is one of the many churches in the diocese of Bologna located in the small towns outside the city and rebuilt or restyled during the XVIII century.  
Local late baroque church architecture is characterised by a sober style, lacking painted decorations, but enriched with some structural features, in this case, the small, elegant lateral choirs in the interior.
artist: Alfonso Torreggiani (Budrio, 1682 – Bologna, 1764) together with Carlo Francesco Dotti. He perfectly employs the so called Barocchetto style: the most elegant and brilliant artistic expression of the local late Baroque.
history: The small church was commissioned by the local Brotherhood of the Assumption. It was designed by Alfonso Torreggiani in 1748 and was built in the following years.
keywords: Religious architecture; stucco decorations; barocchetto
partner: Musei Civici d’Arte Antica di Bologna in cooperation with the Province of Bologna

it.name: Chiesa dell'Assunzione
description:
La facciata sobria ed elegante della chiesa si affaccia su una piazza e funge da quinta architettonica in rapporto ad una delle strade principali. La chiesa è a pianta centrale, con tiburio ottogonale. La facciata in mattoni è composta da due ordini collegati da eleganti volute, un elemento tipicamente barocco.  
Grazie all'abside emisferica l'interno risulta piuttosto spazioso ed è marcato da colonne in stucco bianco; tra di loro si aprono i coretti dalle raffinate cornici di stucco.  
Gli altari datano tra la fine del XVIII e l'inizio del XIX secolo. L'abside è neoclassica.

Questa chiesa fu rinnovata dall'architetto Alfonso Torreggiani. È una delle tante chiese della diocesi di Bologna situate in cittadine fuori dalla grande città e ricostruite o ristrutturate nel XVIII secolo.  
L'architettura religiosa tardo barocca locale è caratterizzata da uno stile sobrio, privo di decorazioni pittoriche, ma è arricchita da elementi strutturali, in questo caso i piccoli, eleganti coretti laterali posti all'interno.
artist:
Alfonso Torreggiani (Budrio, 1682 – Bologna, 1764)  
Uno dei due protagonisti, assieme a Carlo Francesco Dotti, dell'architettura bolognese ed emiliana del XVIII. Utilizza perfettamente il cosiddetto stile Barocchetto: la più brillante ed elegante espressione artistica del tardo barocco locale.
history: La piccola chiesa fu commissionata dalla locale confraternita dell'Assunzione per sostituire la propria vecchia sede. Fu disegnata da Alfonso Torreggiani nel 1748 e fu costruita negli anni seguenti.
keywords: Architettura religiosa; decorazioni in stucco; barocchetto

cs.name: Kazatelna
description: Architekturu kazatelny zcela překrývá sochařská výzdoba. Stříšku nahrazuje skupina prostorově rozvedených a dynamicky pojatých figur v cele s archandělem Michalem na pozadí Boží Prozřetelnosti jako bojovníka proti Antikristu. Řečniště rámují sochy sv. Vincence Ferrerského a sv. Tomáše Akvinského, reliéf zobrazuje zakladatele řádu sv. Dominika. Reliéfy na amboně představují novozákonní scény Pokoušení Krista ďáblem. Expresivně pojednanou a barevně zdůrazněnou podnož tvoří shluk padlých andělů v zoufalých pózách. Winterhalder se inspiroval podobně koncipovaným soklem B. Permosera v Drážďanech, který poznal za svého pobytu ve 30. letech. Projekt iluzivně pojednaného hlavního oltáře realizovali dominikánští bratři.

en.name: Pulpit
description: The pulpit architecture is completely obscured by sculpted decoration. Roofing is absent, replaced by a group of dynamically rendered figures headed by Archangel Gabriel, fighter against the Antichrist and with Divine Providence in the background. The platform is lined with statues of the saints Vincent Ferrer and Thomas Aquinas, while a relief depicts the founder of the Dominican order. Reliefs on the ambo represent New Testament scenes from Christ Tempted by the Devil. The expressively executed coloured pedestal is made up of a host of fallen angels in desperate postures. Winterhalder was inspired by a similar base by B. Permoser in Dresden, with which he had became acquainted in the 1730s. The illusionary architecture of the high altar was executed by the Dominican brothers.

cs.name: *Zimní krajina s bruslaři, venkovským stavením a věží*
description:
Malba inspirovaná holandským krajinářstvím 17. století využívá repusoárový motiv stromu a světelných efektů. Kouzlo kabinetního obrazu spočívá ve vysokém nadhledu a dopodrobna propracovaném provedení, kterému napomáhá podložka – hladká měděná deska. Epické, místy anekdotické motivy  
z  idealizovaného života vesničanů dokreslují romantický motiv věže a venkovského kostela. Kombinace krajiny a žánru vychází ze severské tradice zájmu o detail a podrobné zkoumání skutečnosti. Pojem realismu a s ním spojeného racionalismu zde však můžeme vnímat spíše ve smyslu „nedosažitelné idealistické představy“, spojující podrobnou popisnost s vnitřní citovou představou. Jako touhu po dokonalosti vybraného světa, jež se liší od skutečnosti.  
Holandské malířství bylo malířům vzorem pro techniku, precizní a jemnou malbu.  Od poloviny 18. století je na Akademii ve Vídni vyučována krajinomalba  
„ v holandském stylu“, r. 1768 zde vzniká první krajinářská škola – příznačně na Mědirytecké akademii, kladoucí důraz na techniku a podrobné studium přírody.  
V holandském malířství Zlatého věku jsou spatřovány základní hodnoty, důležité pro společnost 18. století: pospolitost, mravnost, soužití s přírodou, věcnost, krása všednosti. V holandské krajinomalbě byla viděna pravá příroda, motivy  
z vesnického života byly vnímány jako obrazy lidské přirozenosti. Obrazy odvolávající se na nizozemské malířství 17. století byly zvláště vyhledávány pro výzdobu kabinetů. Odpovídaly jejich starožitnému charakteru i dobovému vkusu. Přenášejíce realitu do lyrického světa, vytvářejí idylickou intimní atmosféru. Instalace obrazů má umožnit pozorování zblízka, přistoupit k obrazu a ponořit se do něj, rozlišit nejmenší formy a vedení štětce, jeho techniku, objevovat detaily a číst zobrazené příběhy.

Malba je inspirována holandským krajinářstvím 17. století. Kouzlo kabinetního obrazu spočívá ve vysokém nadhledu a dopodrobna propracovaném provedení, kterému napomáhá podložka – hladká měděná deska. Přenášejíce realitu do lyrického světa, vytváří idylickou atmosféru.
keywords: Kabinet; krajinomalba; žánr

en.name: *Winter Landscape with Skaters, a Country Cottage and a Tower*
description:
The picture was inspired by a 17th-century Dutch painting employing a motif of a tree contrasting with light effects. The magic of this cabinet, or study, image lies in the view from above and the elaborate rendering, facilitated by the base, a smooth copper plate. Epic, occasionally anecdotal motifs, idylls of village life, combine with the romantic representations of a tower and a village church. This combination of landscape and genre painting is rooted in the Scandinavian tradition of attention to detail and meticulous analysis of reality. Yet the realism and inherent rationalism of this picture may also be perceived as an “unattainable ideal”, adding refined descriptiveness to an inner emotional concept to achieve a perfect world that is far from reality.  
Dutch painting provided something of a template for technique, leading to a precise and fine style. In the mid-18th century, the Vienna Academy opened “Dutch-style” courses for landscape painting, and in 1768 the first landscape school was established in Vienna, typically enough at the Copperplate Engraving Academy, where emphasis was placed on technique and detailed study from nature.  
Dutch “Golden Age” painting is associated with the ostensible values of high 18th-century society: communality, morality, co-existence with nature, objectivity, and the beauty of the mundane. Dutch landscape art showed the countryside “true to life”; rural motifs were understood as images of human nature. Pictures reminiscent of Dutch 17th-century paintings were particularly sought-after for the decoration of “cabinets”, or studies, as they were deemed appropriate both to antique modes of room décor and period taste. The pictures were hung in such a way as to encourage close examination by the viewer, who should be immersed in the picture distinguishing even minutiae including brush strokes and the artist's technique, thereby discovering new details and reading the stories conveyed.

The cabinet picture was inspired by 17th-century Dutch painting. Its magic lies in the view from above and the elaborate rendering facilitated by the base, a smooth copper plate. Transferring reality into a lyrical world, the painting creates an idyllic atmosphere.
keywords: Cabinet; landscape; art; genre painting

en.name: *Algiers, site of the Lycée*
short_description: This building was home to the first French educational institution in Algiers, as indicated by its name "Lycée". It was built on the site of an ancient columbarium, not far from where the deys' tombs had been prior to their demolition and the construction of Bab el-Oued esplanade. It was constructed under the direction of the architect Frédéric Chassériau, although the archaeologist Adrien Berbrugger organised excavations before the works began. Today, it is called Lycée Émir Abdelkader, and remains one of the most important scholarly institutions in the city.
keywords: School; traditional city; archaeology

fr.name: *Alger, Emplacement du lycée*
short_description: La dénomination « Lycée » fait référence à la première institution scolaire française construite à Alger, sur l’emplacement d’un ancien colombarium d’époque antique, non loin des tombeaux des deys rasés lors de l’édification de l’esplanade de Bab el-Oued ; édifié par l’architecte Frédéric Chassériau, l’archéologue Adrien Berbrugger y mena des fouilles avant sa construction. Il est aujourd’hui appelé lycée Émir-Abd-el-Kader et demeure un des plus importants sites scolaires de la capitale.
keywords: Ecole; cité traditionnelle; arqueologie

en.name: Tile panel in the form of a doorway
description: This large mosaic tile panel is installed on the east wall of the dining room lanai at Shangri La. To produce a panel such as this, a potter cut small shapes out of glazed and fired tiles, then fitted the small pieces together to produce a mosaic effect. Each shape had to be precisely cut to align perfectly with the surrounding shapes glazed in contrasting colors. The technique was often used in Iran and Central Asia to adorn buildings and other architectural structures such as gateways.
type: Islamic, Indian & Southeast Asian works of art; Tilework; ceramic

ar.name: مطرة رحال.
description:
هذه القارورة المسمّاة بمطرة الرحال عبارة عن آنية تستخدم لحمل الماء أثناء السفر أو الحج أو رحلات الصيد. هذه القطعة نموذج من المطرات المصنوعة بالقالب، جذعها قرصي وزوِّدت بعنق وعروتين على كتف الإناء. حتى لا يندلق الماء، مدَّت الشفة بإضافة عنق أنبوبي متطاول كأنه مكون من عدة حلقات متراكبة تضيق تدريجياً. أما العروتان فيمكن ربطهما بحبل لحمل المطرة أثناء السفر سواءً أكان ذلك على القدمين أم على الحصان أم على ظهر جمل.  
  
أما سطح الجذع فهو يحمل شعاراً مملوكياً (رنكاً) للأمير طقزتمر. الشعار مركب من الكأس والنسر، وهو مكون من نسر باسط جناحيه فوق كأس ووردتين على كل طرف. ويرى علماء الآثار أن طقزتمر كان ساقياً في البداية وشعاره الكأس، ثم ترقى إلى أن أصبح نائباً للسلطنة فاتخذ النسر شعاراً له، وصار يضع الشكلين على آنيته الخاصة. يعتقد البعض أيضاً أن الوردتين التي تتكون كل منهما من ست نويرات رمز لاسم عائلة الناصر محمد بن قلاوون (حكم ثلاث مرات في السنوات 693 – 694 / 1294 – 1295، و 698 – 708 / 1299 – 1309، و 709 – 741 / 1309 – 1340).

قارورة حجّ، تمَّت زخرفتها بشعار، واشتُهر هذا الطراز في الزخرفة في العصر المملوكي، حيث حملت شعاراً يحتوي رسم نسر، بالإضافة الى اسم المالك، وهو الأمير توغوز تيمور، الحاكم المملوكي لمدينة حماه، وفيما بعد حلب.
keywords: حلب؛ رنك؛ صب بالقالب؛ طقزتمر؛ فخار؛ كأس؛ مطرة رحال؛ نسر؛ وعاء ترابي.

en.name: Pilgrim’s Flask.
description:
This canteen, often described as a pilgrim's flask, is a container used to carry water while travelling, on pilgrimage, or hunting trips. It is manufactured using a mould and its body is in the form of a disc with a mouth and a pair of loops attached to the side. To keep water from spilling out, the mouth is elongated by a tube of earthenware resembling a set of gradually narrowing rings stacked one on top of the other. The two loops flanking the flask's mouth can be strung by a rope to hang on the hip while travelling on foot, horse or camel-back.  
The surface of the body is decorated with a moulded imprint boldly portraying a Mamluk blazon, known in Arabic as 'rank'. The open-winged eagle on top of a chalice that is flanked by flowers is known to be the blazon of Prince Toquztimur. It is believed that he started out as an official cup-bearer and his blazontherefore displays the cup. When he rose to the rank of governor for Sultan Nasir al-Din Muhammad (r. AH 709–41 / AD 1309–40), he added the symbol of the eagle as a tribute to the Sultan. The six-petal roses that appear underneath the eagle may signify a tribute to Nasir al-Din's family, the Qalawun.

This flask decorated with an emblem, a fashion that became popular during the Mamluk period, carries a symbol of an eagle and identifies the owner as Prince Toquztimur, the Mamluk Governor of Hama and later Aleppo.
keywords: Pilgrim flasks; canteen; earthenware; pottery; moulded; Aleppo; Toquztimur; blazon (or rank); eagle; cup; al-Nasir Muhammad; pilgrimage

es.name: Cantimplora de peregrino.
description:
Esta cantimplora, de un tipo que suele denominarse “de peregrino”, es un recipiente para llevar agua en los viajes, los peregrinajes o las partidas de caza. Se fabricó con molde, y tiene el cuerpo en forma de disco, con boca y un asa a cada lado. La boca está prolongada por un tubo de barro en forma de anillos apilados que van estrechándose a medida que ascienden y evitan que se salga el agua. Por las asas de los lados pueden pasarsen una cuerda para colgar la cantimplora de la cintura al viajar a pie, a caballo o en camello.  
La superficie de la panza está decorada con un blasón mameluco hecho a molde, denominado en árabe *rank*. Se sabe que el águila con las alas desplegadas sobre un cáliz rodeado de flores era el blasón del príncipe Toquztimur. Se cree que empezó siendo copero oficial, por lo que en su blasón aparece el símbolo de la copa. Cuando ascendió al rango de gobernador del sultán Nasir al-Din Muhammad (r. 709-741 / 1309-1340), agregó el símbolo del águila como homenaje a dicho sultán. La rosa de seis pétalos que se aprecia debajo del águila puede representar un homenaje a la familia de Nasir al-Din, los Qalawun.

Esta cantimplora está decorada con un emblema, motivo muy común durante la época mameluca; lleva el símbolo de un águila e identifica a su propietario como el príncipe Toquztimur, gobernador mameluco de Hama y después de Alepo.
keywords: cantimplora de peregrino; barro cocido; cerámica; moldeado; Alepo; Toquztimur; blasón; rank; águila; copa; al-Nasir Muhammad.

fr.name: Gourde de pèlerin.
description:
Cette gourde, souvent appelée gourde de pèlerin, est un récipient utilisé pour transporter l'eau en voyage, en pèlerinage ou à la chasse. Elle est fabriquée au moule et se compose d'un réservoir circulaire, d'un goulot et de deux bélières. Le goulot en forme de tube cannelé est fait d'anneaux de diamètres décroissants pour permettre de boire sans perdre de liquide. Les deux bélières servent à attacher une cordelette que le voyageur à pied, à cheval ou à dos de chameau accrochait à sa hanche.  
La surface de la panse est décorée d'un blason moulé de style mamelouk appelé *rank* en arabe. L'aigle aux ailes éployées au-dessus d'un calice flanqué de fleurs est le blason du prince Toqouztimour. On pense qu'il débuta sa carrière comme échanson, d'où la présence d'une coupe dans son blason. Lorsqu'il fut élevé au rang de gouverneur par le sultan Nasir al-Din Muhammad (r. 709-741 H / 1309-1340 J.-C.), il y a jouta l'aigle en hommage au sultan. Les roses à six pétales figurant sous le rapace sont peut-être un hommage à la famille de Nasir al-Din, les Qalawun.

Cette gourde décorée d'un emblème, selon une mode devenue populaire pendant la période mamelouke, porte un symbole d'aigle et donne le nom de son propriétaire, le prince Toqouztimour, gouverneur mamelouk d'Hama puis d'Alep.
keywords: Gourde de pèlerin ; terre cuite ; poterie ; moulée ; Alep ; Toqouztimour ; blason ; aigle ; coupe ; al-Nasir Muhammad

en.name: Bedesten
description:
The *bedesten* is a new building type that emerged in the 15th century as a result of the development of commercial life during the Emirates period. Originally constructed to gather fabric sellers called *bezzaz* under one roof, soon other goods began to be sold there as well. Valuable merchandise –like jewellery and money deposited by merchants– was stored and protected in the *bedesten*s, which functioned like the banks of today. Goods were also priced and quality checked in the *bedesten*s, whose officers, chosen among trustworthy persons, also acted as experts in commercial lawsuits.  
In general, *bedesten*s are rectangular structures closed to the outside; stores on all four sides completely surround the structure. A door is located in the centre of each front; the interior is divided into equal-size bays, each of which is covered with a dome; small cells adjoin the interior of the walls; the number of domed sections varies according to the size of the *bedesten*.  
One of the most important *bedesten*s, each of which was a waqf establishment, is the Edirne Bedesten constructed by Sultan Mehmed I. It is known that this bedesten belonged to the Eski Mosque’s *waqf*. It has four *iwan*\-shaped entrances, one in the middle of each front. Each of the windows on the upper section of the main body walls has different stonework decoration to offer the observant; 14 lofty domes cover the main rectangular body of the structure; there are 56 stores on its exterior and 36 cells in its interior; the structure, which has been completely restored, is used as a bazaar today. According to a contemporary account by Evliya Çelebi, it was guarded by night by 60 Janissaries, with the four locked gates, for the goods inside were so valuable.

es.name: Bedesten
description:
Los *bedesten*s son un tipo de edificio que surgió en el siglo XV como consecuencia del desarrollo de la vida comercial en el periodo de los emiratos. Levantados originalmente para reunir bajo un solo techo a los vendedores de telas, llamados *bezzaz*, pronto sirvieron para comercializar también otros productos. En los *bedesten*s se guardaban y custodiaban mercancías preciosas —como joyas y dinero que dejaban en depósito los mercaderes—, así que funcionaban como los bancos de nuestros días. Asimismo, los bazares se ocupaban de fijar el precio y comprobar la calidad de los bienes, por lo que los responsables, que también actuaban como expertos en pleitos comerciales, eran elegidos entre personas fidedignas.  
En general, los *bedesten*s son edificios rectangulares y cerrados al exterior, rodeados de negocios por los cuatro lados. Hay una puerta en el centro de cada lado; el interior se divide en crujías de igual tamaño, cada una cubierta por una cúpula; pegadas a los muros hay pequeñas cámaras, y el número de espacios con cúpula varía según el tamaño del *bedesten*.  
Uno de los *bedesten*s más importantes —todos establecimientos pertenecientes a *waqf*s— es el que hizo construir Mehmet I en Edirne y que, según se sabe, pertenecía al *waqf* de la mezquita Eski. Tiene cuatro entradas en forma de *iwan*, una en medio de cada fachada. Cada ventana de la parte superior de los muros del cuerpo principal ofrece una decoración diferente en piedra; 14 cúpulas elevadas cubren el cuerpo principal rectangular; hay 56 comercios fuera y 36 habitáculos dentro; el edificio, completamente restaurado, se utiliza hoy como bazar. Según Evliya Çelebi, en su época los bienes que guardaba eran tan valiosos que por la noche cerraban las puertas y era vigilado por 60 jenízaros.

en.name: Bab Qinnisrin
description: Bab Qinnisrin stands today as a masterpiece of medieval Syrian military architecture, second only to the entrance gate of the Citadel of Aleppo. Although similarly repeatedly rebuilt and restored between the 4th/10th and 9th/15th centuries, much of its late Ayyubid form, dated to 654/1256, is retained. Before losing its east tower, Bab Qinnisrin consisted of two massive and unequal towers with chamfered fronts, of which the west tower was defensive, while that on the east contained the actual portal. This portal, which is equipped with a defensive sliding gate called a portcullis, leads to two rectangular halls separated by another portcullised gateway. A third defensive gate opens up to a final square chamber providing access to the city. More than just a gate, Bab Qinnisrin was a fortress in its own regard, with two wells and a water cistern, flourmills, facilities for the production of olive oil, a bakery and an arsenal.

en.name: A map of the area around the 'Turkish graveyard' in the town of Livorno (Tuscany). The graveyard is represented as a small green rectangle
short_description: In 1762, Muslims living in Livorno were granted a plot of land outside the city walls, near the beach, to build a graveyard (highlighted in green in the map). The graveyard remained in use until the second half of the 19th century. A Muslim graveyard existed in Livorno even before the 18th century. A significant Muslim community lived in the town. Its first members were captives taken to Italy as slaves. Muslim traders settled in town as well. In 1856, the graveyard was enlarged and surrounded by walls. In 1872 it was demolished to build a road and some of the graves were moved to the city graveyard.

en.name: Bau der Ḥiğâzbahn [graphic] : Schienenlegung bei Tebûk. 1906.
names: Construction of the Hijaz railroad : Laying the rails near Tabuk. 1906 eng.
description: This photograph entitled Bau der Ḥiğâzbahn [graphic] : Schienenlegung bei Tebûk. 1906 or Construction of the Hijaz railroad: Laying the rails near Tabuk. 1906 shows workers laying the rails near Tabuk as part of the Hijaz Railway. It is taken by Moritz Bernhard, and represents plate 56 in the portfolio: Bilder aus Palästina. Nord-Arabien und dem Sinai published in Berlin : Dietrich Riemer in 1916. It shows the harsh conditions these workers witnessed, working in a desert landscape under very difficult conditions. The image records the work of assembling the railway track as construction advanced southwards towards Medina, documenting the manual labour involved in extending the line through the desert.
holder: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

en.name: AC generator
description: In 1891, Charles Brown of Great Britain and Walter Boveri of Germany started an electrical engineering business in canton of Aargau. During its first year, Brown, Boveri & Co. had 70 employees. Only ten years later, that number had grown to over 1500. This steep increase was partly due to the success of the alternating current generator which the company began to produce in 1895. Europe was just discovering the benefits of electricity and demand was growing by the day. Switzerland had been an immigration country for generations and offered its new residents opportunities to realise their entrepreneurial dreams. In addition to Brown and Boveri, these immigrant entrepreneurs included the Austrian Carl Franz Bally, the founder of the shoe factory that bears his name, as well as the German pharmacist Henri Nestlé. Other famous brands like Rolex, Maggi, and Hero also owe their existence to the initiative of immigrants. The Jacobs, Hayeks, and Huxleys of this world continue to drive the Swiss economy to this day – just like a powerful generator.
keywords: Generator; Electricity; Brown; Boveri; Baden

en.name: Oršić Palace
description:
By way of its organisation of space and volume, and its relationship with the surrounding outlying parkland, Oršić Palace occupies a leading position in the Late Baroque architecture of inland Croatia. In its individual typological features, the palace bears the stamp of intimacy. Within the wider context of its geographic location and the period in which it was built the palace reflects a kind of Late Baroque revival, revealing innovations that were brought into Central European architecture by some of the great names of the High Baroque such as Fischer von Erlach and Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt.    
This is a palace with an oval-shaped, pavilion-concept central hall. These aesthetically articulated stylistic features are married with traditional elements of a centuries-old feudal tradition in Hrvatsko Zagorje.  
Built within extensive grounds, the two-storey palace features a three-winged, U-shaped ground plan, with a central zone and corner projections emphasised by their volume. In line with this axial concept is the formation of the central entranceway on the ground floor (flanked by a staircase), and the oval dome-ceilinged hall on the first floor, which rises up into the roof zone and forms a prominent, convex projection on the façade.  
Near the courtyard, the traditional passageway was retained but was opened up with arcades and, apart from the central hall, within the sequences of rooms along the external façade, only the private chapel at the end of the lateral wing stands out. The plastic articulation of the palace is in keeping with an accepted organisation of space and volume. Thus the convex façade projection is emphasised by a portal on the ground floor and a large row of pilasters on the first floor, while the same space inside is characterised by the articulation of *trompe l'œil* fresco windows within which are painted landscapes. How the surrounding landscape may have looked after the gradual devastation of the environment is calculable by studying the surviving plan of the park. In addition to a standard Baroque-style, axially placed avenue approach the palace grounds contain Romantic, organically designed plantations, walks and water features.  
These stylistic and typological features suggest a refined client and a knowing and sensitive architect at work, who were able as the Baroque era waned, to call once again on the supreme achievements of Viennese secular architecture: the well-known Imperial Library in the Hofburg (1722), a supreme example of an intricate Central European building with a central oval hall.

Oršić Palace in Gornja Bistra represents Baroque palaces at the peak of their development in inland Croatia. Within the framework of three-winged complexes organised around a central axis, the concept of the Hildebrandt pavilion is expressed in the central zone of the palace where the roof of the main hall is not only raised higher but with its oval, convex form is made even more prominent on the facade. The rich plastic articulation and *trompe l'œil* window frescoes, together with the radial disposition of the fenestration, makes the palace the entire focus of the surrounding parkland.
artist: Unknown architect and fresco painter; painter: Franz Anton Maulbertsch (1724–1796)
history: Vice-marshal Krsto Oršić II built the palace on his estate, which is on the western slopes of Medvednica not far from Zagreb.
keywords: Gornja Bistra, Oršić Palace, Late Baroque, three-winged ground plan, oval hall, grounds

en.name: Vase
description: In the complete course of art history, rarely has there been a movement in which the decorative arts played such an integral role as Art Nouveau. Among these arts, glass held the most important role by far. As a very flexible and mostly transparent material, glass provided an ideal medium in which artists of the movement could express their ideas that were inspired by nature and organic forms. The style, originating in England, spread throughout Europe; yet the most notable places it set its roots were Belgium, France, the Czech Republic, Germany and Austria. Known as Jugendstil in the German-speaking lands, the movement beared witness to divine glass creations from many, now world-famous, craftspeople who have truly earned honourable mentions in the history of the decorative and applied arts. An essential place for the birth and development of the Jugendstil in Vienna was the Wiener Werkstätte (Vienna Workshops), founded by Josef Hoffmann and Koloman Moser. The main aim of the workshops was to bring the artist or designer closer to the craftspeople and technicians entrusted with the execution of their designs, while also encouraging the designers to be their own crafters. The Wiener Werkstätte was one of Hoffmann’s central projects throughout his long life. Therefore, his contribution to the art of the Austrian Jugendstil is a multi-faceted one, ranging from architecture to the decorative arts. This example follows the more nature-oriented aspect of Art Nouveau glassmaking, presenting a blow moulded, tulip-formed vase with bulges. The radiant yellow colour further symbolises the beauty of primary, natural colours. These kinds of objects were supposed to harmonise themselves among other objects in their area and were deliberately made for specific interiors and purposes.
artist: Hoffmann, Josef (design); Böhmische Manufaktur (manufacturer); Wiener Werkstätte (client / customer)
materials: Glass; stained, blown, blow molding, formed
partner: MAK – Austrian Museum of Applied Arts / Contemporary Art

en.name: Ottoman coin – 10 Kurush 1876
short_description: After Moldavia and Wallachia became vassals of the Ottoman Empire, their rulers lost the right to struck coins. Therefore, commercial exchanges were done using foreign coins, the most widely  circulated being Ottoman coinage. Things changed in the second half of the 19th century when national coins were issued in the United Principalities starting with 1867.

en.name: Floor mat
description: An almost complete mat has perimetrical bands with lozenge designs and triangular motifs. It combines brocaded decoration with self-patterned elements such as the beaded medallions in the centre. Two parallel lines of inscriptions are included in the composition and repeat the same word *baraka* (blessing) in a poorly executed *kufic* script. Geniza records describe how such reed mats were used to cover the floor surface and how detailed descriptions might be given to weavers in order to fill every available space. Based on this information, this small mat could be part of a larger commission, used to fill specific recesses or the entrance of a room.
keywords: Floor mat; kufic script; inscription band; geometric
materials: Plain weave with brocaded decoration, hemp and bast fibre; fringe along one edge
tags: Plain weave with brocaded decoration, hemp and bast fibre

en.name: Tomb of Rachel
description:
Rachel was the wife of Jacob and mother of Joseph and Benjamin. She died after giving birth to Benjamin (Jacob’s 12th child) and it is widely believed she was buried in this spot, which bears the name Qubba of Rachel. Rachel’s Tomb was mentioned in the early travel literature of Palestine dating to 4th century, and is still mentioned in various travel and geographical books, whether written by Muslims, Christians or Jews. Al-Idrissi (d. 560/1165) mentioned the site, saying: *“Midway to Bethlehem lies the Tomb of Rachel, the mother of Joseph and Benjamin, Jacob’s sons. The tomb has 12 stones and a dome on top, which is carved in the rock.”* The date and the name of the founder of the building are unknown, but it was probably built in the early Islamic period.  
The travellers’ sources all agree that the tomb consisted of 12 stones, corresponding to the number of Rachel’s sons. The tomb, which is surmounted by a dome, was regularly visited. Muhammad Pasha, the Governor of Jerusalem, commissioned the building of the current structure in 1033/1623, and it was renovated during the Egyptian rule in the early 13th/19th century. The square building has a dome and a long room to the east. In the eastern courtyard is a *mihrab*, in addition to a large number of Muslim tombs, belonging to those who sought Rachel’s blessing.  
Lately, high walls and defence towers have been added to the site, which has been under Israeli control since 1967 and been transformed into a military fort.

es.name: Tumba de Raquel
description:
Raquel fue una de las esposas de Jacob y la madre de José y de Benjamín. Su muerte se produjo tras el alumbramiento de su hijo menor Benjamín, el duodécimo hijo de Jacob, y se cree que fue enterrada en este lugar llamado Qubba de Raquel. La tumba de Raquel aparece mencionada en la primera literatura de viajes sobre Palestina que se remonta al siglo IV de la era cristiana, así como en las obras de los viajeros y geógrafos cristianos, judíos y musulmanes. Al-Idrisi (m. 560/1165) la menciona en estos términos: “A mitad del camino que lleva a Belén está la tumba de Raquel, madre de José y de Benjamín, los hijos de Jacob. La tumba presenta doce piedras y está cubierta con una cúpula que se eleva desde la roca”. Aunque se desconoce la fecha de construcción del edificio y quién fue su constructor, es probable que fuese erigida en los primeros tiempos del Islam.  
Los testimonios que nos han proporcionado los viajeros coinciden en señalar que la tumba estaba compuesta por doce piedras, probablemente en alusión al número de hijos de Jacob. El edificio, coronado por una cúpula, era muy visitado. El que existe en la actualidad fue mandado construir por el gobernador de Jerusalén Muhammad Pacha en 1033/1623, y a finales del siglo XIII/XIX fue restaurado. El edificio es cuadrado y presenta una cúpula y una estancia alargada en su lado este; en el patio oriental se encuentran un *mihrab* y un gran número de tumbas de musulmanes que deseaban la protección de Raquel.  
Más tarde se han añadido unas altas murallas y torres para proteger el monumento que, bajo control israelí desde el año 1967, ha sido transformado en cuartel militar.

fr.name: Tombeau de Rachel
description:
Rachel était l’une des épouses de Jacob, la mère de Joseph et de Benjamin. Elle mourut à la naissance de ce dernier (le douzième enfant de Jacob), et l’on admet généralement qu’elle est enterrée à l’endroit qui porte le nom de Qubba de Rachel. Le tombeau de Rachel est mentionné dans la première littérature de voyage de Palestine, qui remonte au IVe siècle de l’ère chrétienne; il est également cité dans différents ouvrages de voyageurs et de géographes, qu’ils soient chrétiens,musulmans ou juifs. Al-Idrisi (m. 560/1165) l’évoque en ces termes: “À mi-chemin sur la route de Bethléem se trouve la tombe de Rachel, mère de Joseph et de Benjamin, fils de Jacob. La tombe présente douze pierres, elle est coiffée d’une coupole qui s’élève du rocher.” Nous ne connaissons ni le fondateur, ni la date de construction de l’édifice, qui semble cependant remonter au premier âge islamique.  
Les témoignages de voyageurs s’accordent sur le fait que la tombe est composée de douze pierres, ce qui correspond au nombre des enfants de Jacob. L’édifice, qui est surmonté d’une coupole, était régulièrement visité. C’est le gouverneur de Jérusalem Muhammad Pacha qui fit construire en 1033/1623 l’édifice actuel, lequel fut restauré au début du XIIIe/XIXe siècle. Le bâtiment de plan carré présente un dôme et une longue pièce à l’est; dans la cour orientale se trouve un *mihrab*, ainsi que de nombreuses tombes de musulmans qui recherchaient la protection de Rachel.  
Plus tard, de hauts murs et des tours de défense ont été ajoutés au bâtiment qui, sous contrôle israélien depuis 1967, a été transformé en caserne.

en.name: Babouches [slippers] given to the King of Italy by an Ambassador from Morocco visiting Italy in 1890
short_description:
In 1890, the Sultan of Morocco sent Hagi El Maati el Mazamizi as an ambassador to Italy. The Ambassador landed in Naples on June 7th and arrived by train in Rome on June 13th. At the railway station he was received by the Mayor or Rome, the Prefect, and other authorities. A military band was playing and military men in high uniform were paraded in the station to greet the Ambassador.  
Outside the station, three of the King’s gala carriages were waiting for the Ambassador and a military unit was paraded in his honour. Some carabinieri in high uniform escorted the Ambassador to the hotel.  
Hagi El Maati el Mazamizi presented the King with gifts, including some superb horses that the King immensely appreciated. The King presented the Ambassador with a magnificent small gold and diamond box and a hunting rifle and gave gold watches to the members of his escort.
holder: National Museum of Prehistory and Ethnography
partner: MIBACT | National Museum of Prehistory and Ethnography “Luigi Pigorini”

en.name: Water jug
short_description: A copper circular-shaped ewer with a very narrow neck, arched handle and strait long nozzle, used in mosques of Jordan and Palestine to wash before praying. This is another example of how the same objects, traditions, and activities were common in territories that now belong to different Arab states. In the late 19th century and early 20th century, there were still no boundaries between the Arab states and this – together with the lack of geographical barriers – made population movements, nomadism and migration a common factor influencing the everyday life and exchanges in the local society. The local economy, which relied heavily on trade and crafts, depended also on travel and migration in order to sell products or find markets for craft products.
holder: Jordan Museum for Costumes and Jewellery, Department of Antiquities
keywords: ewer; copper; nozzle; mosques
partner: Jordan Museum for Costumes and Jewellery

en.name: Villino Volterra (V. dei Villini 39)
description:
The villa, with entrances on via Appia Nuova (via dei Villini, n. 39) and via Vito Volterra (n. 1), was designed in liberty style in 1904 by architect Giulio Magni (1859–1930). The building overlooks the garden-antiquarium, rich in archaeological finds of Roman *Aricia*, and with its belvedere where the statue of the Lady of the Winds, sculpted by Giuseppe Magni, can be seen, it stands out as one of the most important architectural elements of the Alban landscape. The villa was commissioned as his country residence by the great mathematician Vito Volterra (1860–1940), who was also senator and president of the Lincean Academy and of the Italian National Research Council. Ownership then passed to his heirs and his son, the distinguished jurist Edoardo Volterra (1904–1984). Throughout the years, Villa Volterra has hosted several prestigious scientists, such as Madame Marie Curie and the mathematician Tullio Levi Civita, Einstein's consultant during the elaboration of the theory of relativity. The building, now owned by Virginia Volterra, was radically restored between 2004 and 2010 under the direction of architect Roberto Veneziani.  
(Bibliography: A. Martorelli, 1930; R. Veneziani, V. Volterra, 2011)

en.name: Perfume Bottle
description:
This is a fine and early example of a series of janiform head-flasks in glass. It was made in a two part mould and each of the two heads (related to the Roman god, Janus) is the same. Such mould-blown janiform bottles seem to originate in the first century AD and widely seen around the Eastern Mediterranean region. Janus masks continued being made into the third and fourth centuries. The janiform bottle has been used as a scent bottle which most probably belonged to the wealthy Roman households. It was used to store aromatic and herbal oils, as well as perfumes.  
The double-faced glass bottle is made from clear glass which is light-blue in colour and it has a long cylindrical neck which protrudes from the centre of the head. The head has wavy hair and clear facial features which provide a naturalistic appearance. The bottom of the neck has been flattened so as to make a base for the bottle.
keywords: Glass in Asia Minor; Roman period; casting; blowing; mould-blowing

en.name: Tile Panel for a Spandrel
description: Buildings in Isfahan, capital of the Safavid dynasty in the seventeenth century, were lavishly decorated with tilework. An innovation of this period, found in palaces and other secular structures, was the use of individually painted square tiles, which were combined to form a larger pictorial scene and employed the *cuerda seca* technique. First developed in Iran in the later 14th century, *cuerda seca* was designed to produce multicolored glazed tile decoration quickly, efficiently, and cheaply. To prevent the different glazes from running during the (single) firing process, the decorative motifs were outlined with a greasy pigment that burned off in the firing, leaving behind a dull, dark line. This tile panel is half of a pair of spandrels that was once set above an archway in a palatial pavilion known as the Hasht Bihisht, completed in Hegira 1080 / AD 1669-70. Here, amid a tranquil floral landscape filled with birds, a lion attacks a stag, a motif that can perhaps be interpreted as a visualization of a contemporary poetic metaphor for the arrival of spring. Other contemporaneous spandrels from the Hasht Bihisht on the eastern facade include animal combats, for example, a leopard and a gazelle and a tiger and a gazelle.
holder: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)
place: Iran, probably Isfahan, Hasht Bihisht, West façade
keywords: Ceramics; fritware; cuerda seca; Iran; Safavid; animal decoration; floral motifs; lion; bird

cs.name: *Archanděl Rafael s malým Tobiášem*
description: Černé boční oltáře se zlacením vytvářejí spolu s kazatelnou kontrast k bílé, jednoduchým štukem s vegetabilními motivy zdobené klenbě. V postavě Tobiáše spatřujeme mladého šlechtice z rodu Dietrichštejna, jehož erb má chlapec na rameni. en.name: *Archangel Raphael with Little Tobias*
description: Black gilded side altars pose a contrast, together with a pulpit, to the white vaulting decorated with simple stucco featuring vegetal motifs. The figure of Tobias personifies count Dietrichstein, whose coat of arms is on the boy’s shoulder. The guardian angel accompanies him on the journey to the divine light, leading him on the path of virtue and protecting him from sins and vices. M. A. Lublinský is also attributed with the replica of a picture by P. P. Rubens on the opposite altar.

en.name: Fortress and Promontory
description:
The promontory, the fortress and, most of all, legend marks Sagres. It was thought to have been here that Prince Henry the Navigator founded his famous “Sagres School”, where the art of navigation was studied and mariners trained. Although this tradition has been destroyed by solid arguments, the place still lives upon the myth. It is true that Prince Henry did have one of his residences nearby, in Raposeira, where he had a *quinta*, and it also seems to be true that techniques, ships and instruments were tested in the bay at Sagres and São Vicente.  
In the Manueline era, there was a sufficiently large population for the area to be designated a parish. There was also a fortress on the promontory that developed naturally, making a wall that isolated the area. The wall enclosed the Chapel of Nossa Senhora da Graça, houses, barracks and other constructions. The present fortifications were completed in 1793.

en.name: Bowl painted in blue and black
description: The type of thin-walled bowls of an elegant bi-conic shape/decorated with refined blue and black painting belongs to the best achievements of Iranian ceramics of the AD 12th–13th centuries. The inner surface of the museum bowl is decorated with a cross-shaped composition with radial inscriptions in Persian, scratched on black ribbons in the "dry kalam" technique. The inscriptions make up a love poem: "Since you cannot love me for a moment / Do not break further my wounded heart. / Be less cruel, less tyrannical to me, / Until my heart slowly leaves you". Masterly drawn flowers, long-tailed birds and "willow branches" betray the hand of a subtle artist.
keywords: Ceramics; Iran; Kashan
materials: Stonepaste; painting in black and blue under a clear glaze

ar.name: صحن.
description:
صحن من نوع "برازيريو" ذو قاعدة دائرية مُسطحة، وجوانب مستقيمة وقليلة العمق، منتهية بجناح ضيق. صُنعت القطعةُ من صلصال مائل إلى الأحمر ومغطى بطلاء حاوٍ للقصدير؛ وتقدمُ زخرفةً ذات بريق معدني من المذهَّب وأزرق الكوبالت، فوق خلفية بيضاء صوفية. قُسِّم قعرُ الصحن المزخرف بزينة نباتية منمنمة غرناطية إلى أرباع، مع تناوب عناصر زرقاء ومذهبة؛ ويقدم الجناح زخرفة أرابيسك مع شرائط رقيقة زرقاء مجدولة؛ وتُظهرُ الفروقَ الدقيقة للقعر الأبيض الصوفي لهذا الأخير قواقعُ مذهبة تشغل الفراغات.  
ومن الناحية التقنية، يبقى فخار القرنين الرابع عشر والخامس عشر استمراراً للخزف الموحدي؛ لكن إدخال أكسيد الكوبالت خلال الفترة النصرية في الطلاء سمح بتوفير تشكيلة واسعة من التدرجات الزرقاء؛ وبفضل استخدام سلفور النحاس والفضة والصدأ من أجل الحصول على البريق المعدني، تم إحراز قطعاً استثنائية؛ وبلغ الخزف الأندلسي المذهَّب، الذي كان يصنع سلفاً خلال القرون الماضية، أوجَهُ في ظل الدولة النصرية بغرناطة.  
كانت صناعة هذا النوع من الفخار تتطلب طهيه ثلاث مرات؛ فكانت الأخيرة المنجزة في فرن مخفض للتأكسد الأصعب لأنها تقتضي سيطرة كاملة على درجة حرارة الفرن؛ وكان يجب التحام خليط السلفورات المعدنية للقطعة دون ترك طلاء الطهي السالف يتعرض للذوبان.  
إن أهمية محترفات مملكة غرناطة المتخصصة في الفخار، وبشكل خاص محترفات مالقة بوصفها مركزاً كبيراً للإنتاج، قد أدت إلى جعل عبارة "إنتاج مالقة" مع قراءات مختلفة قليلاً، تعادل "الفخار المذهَّب" بغض النظر عن موضع الإنتاج. كما جرى استعمال هذه التسمية في العالم المسيحي على يد فخارين من أصل نصري، ممن رحلوا منذ نهاية القرن الرابع عشر نحو الشرق واستقروا في مواضع مختلفة، من بينها مانيسيس التي كانت المركز الأهم للفخار ذي البريق المعدني، المصنوع حسب أسلوب مالقة من أجل عملاء مسيحيين.

يمثل هذا الطبق الكبير استمرار تقنية وزخرفة الخزف النصري داخل الورشات المدجنة من أجل الاستجابة لحاجيات الزبائن المسيحيين الطالبين لأشكال جديدة، مثل شكل هذا الإناء قليل العمق، ذي القاعدة المسطحة والجوانب المستقيمة والحافة الأفقية.
place: مملكة بني نصر بغرناطة أو مملكة فالانسيا المسيحية.
