en.name: Parish Church of Our Lady of the Snow
description:
A network of elongated *rocaille* scrolls and cartouches, into which floral twigs and garlands are interwoven covers the walls of the church like lace to form a framework for the wall paintings. Due to the long construction period, the stucco decoration was created over a long period, but nonetheless is based on an extensive, uniform iconographic programme. The Marian topics include the *Legend of Our Lady of the Snow* and the *Foundation of the Roman Church of Santa Maria Maggiore* shown in a number of scenes in the sanctuary of the church (transposed into one of them is a contemporary depiction of the foundation of the church in Kutina). Considerable space on the walls and ceiling of the nave is devoted to the *Passion*. Accompanying these is a sequence of emblematic depictions based on the Old Testament as well as motifs relating to the Mysteries of the Joyful, Sorrowful and Glorious Rosaries.  
Authorship of the wall paintings has not been thoroughly elucidated yet, partly because in the forms the personal styles of three painters can be observed, while the only signatures to be identified are those of Franciscus Weitenhiller of 1776, and Joann Joseph Görner (probably a Varaždin painter) of 1779. While Görner painted the ceiling paintings in the nave, Franciscus Weitenhiller painted the figurative images on the walls of the sanctuary and nave (many of which were subsequently heavily retouched) integrated in the "lace" of the *rocaille* stuccowork. Because of the misspelled signature, the author was at first identified as Josep Weitenhiller (who it is recorded worked in Slovenia). There are also some excellent woodcarvings. The High altar (1739) is attributed stylistically to the Zagreb sculptor, Joseph Weinacht. Weinacht was one of the most accomplished local sculptors of the first half of the 18th century whose style shows the influence of contemporary Styrian sculpture, which suggests that he trained there. The pulpit (around 1761) is ascribed to the Zagreb sculptor, Franjo or Franz Straub (1726–before 1771), and is classified as among the most luxurious and opulent Baroque embodiments in north-west Croatia, as well as an outstanding specimen of dynamism aspiring towards the monumental, characteristics that define his work.

A church with a nave only and no aisles, it has a belfry on the facade and is surrounded by a covered walkway. The simplicity of the exterior is much at odds with the rich interior, which is among the most luxuriously fitted-out Baroque churches of northern Croatia. The integrity of the opulent Baroque interior is achieved above all through the rich stucco decoration that covers the walls like lacework, framing the wall paintings dedicated to Marian and Christological subjects.
dates: High altar: 1739; pulpit: c. 1761; stucco work and wall painting: 1765–1779
artist: Count Karlo II Erdödy and his wife Countess Erdödy, *née* Kohary

Painters: J. Weitenhiller (active c. 1770), Joann Joseph Görner (active c. 1770), Ivan Krstitelj (Johann Baptist) Ranger (1700–1753); sculptors: Joseph Weinacht (active c. 1740–1750), Franjo (Franz) Straub (1726–before 1771)
history: The Baroque church was built on the site of an older building. Construction took a long 40 years, with the sanctuary completed in 1729; the nave in 1748 and building concluded in 1769. Count Karlo Erdödy II and his wife, Countess Erdödy, financed the construction and fitting-out of the church from 1740.

en.name: *Portrait of Father António Vieira*
description:
In this engraving Arnold van Westerhout represents the humanist, António Vieira, as a man of knowledge and a father of the Society of Jesus. His gaze extends beyond the horizon: whether towards Brazil where he grew up or to Lisbon, the home he always defended with the staunchness he employed to preach the Christian faith. The Flemish artist concentrates on António Vieira's facial expression to heighten his altruistic character which is shown in constant reflection about the human condition and his own experience of it.  
This painting celebrates António Vieira's exemplary life dedicated to the defence of human rights, whether to those of Brazil's indigenous peoples or the Jews persecuted by the Inquisition.  
Born in Lisbon in 1608, António Vieira departed to S. Salvador da Bahia with his parents at the age of six. He entered the Society of Jesus in 1623 and become a priest 12 years later. He played a fundamental role in the relationship between Jesuits, coloniser and the indigenous peoples of Brazil, exhibiting in his sermons an anxiety about the socio-political conditions that would characterise his missionary activity. With knowledge of the languages and costumes of the Brazilian Indians he was a missionary and a preacher with a humanistic vision.  
Following independence from Spanish domination, Vieira returned to Lisbon where he became an important figure in the court of King João IV. He rapidly became a key player in state decisions and helped re-establish the Portuguese Empire's economic, political, diplomatic and religious profile in Lisbon and in the most important colony at the time, Brazil. In the latter, and at Vieira's advice, the Commercial Company of Brazil was instituted with two intentions: to resist Dutch invasion and to foment the recovery of local sugar production with the objective of export to Europe.  
In Lisbon he proposed economic reforms that would force a change in the doctrine of the Inquisition. He terminated the distinction between 'new-Christians' and 'old Christians' in order to attract the investments of Jews who had fled the Kingdom. The idea generated a conflict with the Society of Jesus and the Dominicans, which resulted in António Vieira being persecuted by the Inquisition.  
Later in his life he was one again accused of heresy. This was as a result of a letter he sent to the Bishop of Japan in which he outlined his *Theory of the Fifth Empire*. Here he predicted that Portugal was predestined to be the next grand empire following the Assyrian, Greek, Persian and Roman.

An engraving by Arnold van Westerhout of António Vieira, a Portuguese Jesuit Priest, writer and preacher. As a senior diplomat as well as a missionary in Brazil, he became both an influential figure in Portuguese culture and in the defence of human rights of indigenous peoples.
keywords: Brazil; sermon; engraving

pt.name: *Retrato do Padre António Vieira*
description:
Nascido em Lisboa, em 1608, António Vieira cedo partiu para o Brasil, onde integrou a Companhia de Jesus, em 1623, e foi ordenado sacerdote 12 anos mais tarde. Teve um papel fundamental na relação entre os jesuítas, os colonos e os indígenas, pois revelou, desde cedo, nos seus sermões, preocupações sócio-políticas que caracterizaram a sua acção missionária. Após a restauração da independência face ao domínio filipino, Vieira regressou a Lisboa, onde se tornou uma figura fundamental junto do rei D. João IV, participando nas decisões régias, reunindo apoio das principais cortes europeias e contribuindo para o restabelecimento do Império.  
Por seu conselho, foi instituída a Companhia do Comércio do Brasil para criar uma resistência às invasões holandesas e fomentar a recuperação da produção de açúcar na região, que teria a Europa como destino. Na metrópole, propôs uma reforma económica que incluía a reorganização da Inquisição, pondo fim à distinção entre cristãos-novos e cristãos-velhos, com vista ao investimento financeiro dos judeus fugidos do reino. Esta iniciativa gerou um conflito com a Companhia de Jesus e com os Dominicanos, tendo sido, inclusivamente, perseguido pela Inquisição.  
Mais tarde, voltou a ser acusado de heresia, com base numa carta ao Bispo do Japão, na qual exprimia a sua teoria do Quinto Império, segundo a qual Portugal estava predestinado a ser o próximo grande império, a seguir aos da Antiguidade.  
António Vieira é representado por Arnold van Westerhout como um homem do saber, padre da Companhia de Jesus, com um olhar que se perde para lá do horizonte, quer se trate do Brasil, onde cresceu, quer de Lisboa, pátria que sempre defendeu com o mesmo fulgor com que pregou a fé cristã. A expressão que o artista flamengo imprimiu no rosto de António Vieira coloca em evidência o seu carácter altruísta, de reflexão constante sobre a condição humana e, sobretudo, vivido e experiente. Na realidade, esta gravura é um ex-voto enaltecendo a vida exemplar de António Vieira, consagrada à defesa dos direitos dos indígenas do Brasil e dos judeus, vítimas dos autos inquisitoriais.

Gravura de Arnold van Westerhout representando a vera efígie de António Vieira, padre jesuíta, escritor e orador português. Importante diplomata, tornou-se numa das mais influentes figuras da cultura portuguesa e da defesa dos direitos humanos dos povos indígenas, enquanto missionário no Brasil.
keywords: Padre António Vieira; Brasil; sermões; gravura.

en.name: London–Cairo in 7 Days by Train. Simplon-Orient-Express
description: Travel poster showing the silhouette of a woman carrying a pot on her head among palm trees by the Nile, with the pyramids in the distance, advertising the London–Cairo route via the Simplon Orient Express and its connecting services. Operated by the "Compagnie Internationale des Wagons-Lits" (International Sleeping-Car Company), the journey combined the Simplon Orient Express from London to Istanbul with onward rail, road and sea connections through Anatolia, the Levant and Palestine, reaching Cairo in approximately seven days. Designed by French illustrator Jacques Touchet (1887–1949), known for his work in magazine and book illustration, the poster dates to 1930.
keywords: Tourism; Middle East; 20th Century; Orient Express; railway companies; Middle East; Travel posters

ar.name: زبدية عليها رسم لعازف ربابة.
description:
زبدية مزخرفة، في وسطها رسم يمثل عازف ربابة؛ وهي آلة موسيقيه ذات أوتار، عرفت بالعراق. والأرضية حول العازف ملأى بضربات فرشاة الفنان تاركة نقاطاً. أما الحافة فمزينة بأشكال دائرية.  
يبدو لنا عازف الربابة جالساً جلسة عربية، ممسكاً ربابته بيده، تجسيداً للحياة الإسلامية؛ أو كأنه يذكر بشارب الخمر الذي عرف ضمن حاشية الحاكم في الغرب. إن صورة العازف تشبه الرسوم التي توجد على خزف نيسابور في الفترة الزمنية نفسها، إلا أنه يتميز بغطاء الرأس الذي كانت شعوب تركيا ومنغوليا وآسيا الوسطى تستعمله.
يقدم زخرف هذه القطعة من بين عناصر أخرى شاخصا مذكرا منشغلا بالعزف على آلة ذات أوتار، "الرباب". إن صورة الموسيقي هذه اعتيادية في الفن الإسلامي؛ ويبدو أنها تشير، مثل صورة  الشارب، إلى حياة وأبهة البلاط.

en.name: Cup with *rubab* player.
description:
The cup is decorated in the centre with a figure playing a *rubab*, a traditional Iranian stringed instrument. The background is filled with dotted panels and the edge is decorated with semi-circles.  
The *rubab*\-player motif, shown here seated as was the custom among nomads, appears frequently in Islamic art and seems, like the figure of the drinker, to evoke court scenes in celebration of the life of the sovereign. The musician, depicted in a style similar to that used in figurative Nishapur ceramics from the same period, is wearing characteristic headgear that was common among Turco-Mongolian people in Central Asia.

This piece is decorated with, among other things, a male figure playing a stringed instrument, the *rubab*. The figure of the musician is common in Islamic art and, like the figure of the drinker, appears to evoke the splendour of court life.
holder: Museum of Civilisations | Museum of Oriental Art “Giuseppe Tucci”
keywords: Ceramic; lustre; geometric decoration; decoration
partner: Museum of Civilisations | Museum of Oriental Art

es.name: Cuenco con tañedor de *rubab*.
description:
El centro del cuenco está ocupado por la figura de un tañedor de *rubab*, instrumento de cuerda de tradición irania. El fondo aparece cubierto por secciones punteadas, mientras que el borde está decorado con adornos semicirculares.  
El motivo del tañedor de *rubab*, que aquí aparece sentado como era costumbre entre los nómadas, es frecuente en el arte islámico y parece evocar, como también la figura del bebedor, escenas cortesanas en alabanza de la vida del soberano. El músico, representado en un estilo muy similar al que se encuentra en la cerámica figurativa de Nishapur de la misma época, va tocado con un característico sombrero muy popular entre los pueblos turcomongoles de Asia central.

La decoración de este cuenco muestra, entre otros elementos, una figura masculina tocando un instrumento de cuerda, el *rubab*. Las figuras de músicos son habituales en el arte islámico y parecen evocar, al igual que las figuras de bebedores, la vida y los fastos de la corte.
holder: Museo de Civilizaciones | Museo de Arte Oriental “Giuseppe Tucci”
dates: Siglo IV de la Hégira / X d. C.
keywords: cerámica; reflejo metálico
partner: Museo de Civilizaciones | Museo de Arte Oriental

fr.name: Coupe avec joueur de *rubâb*.
description:
La coupe est décorée, au centre, avec la silhouette d'un joueur de “rubâb”, instrument à cordes de tradition iranienne. Le fond est orné de compartiments remplis de pointillés, le bord décoré de motifs de demi-lunes.  
Le motif du joueur de“rubâb”, représenté ici selon l'habitude des nomades, est récurrent dans l'art islamique et semble évoquer, comme la figure du buveur, des scènes de cour célébrant la vie du souverain. Le musicien, rendu dans un style semblable à celui que l'on retrouve dans la céramique figurative de Nishapour, de la même période, porte un couvre-chef caractéristique, en usage chez les peuples turco-mongols d'Asie centrale.

Le décor de cette pièce présente, entre autres éléments, une silhouette masculine occupée à jouer d'un instrument à cordes, le *rubâb*. La figure du musicien est habituelle dans l'art islamique et semble évoquer, tout comme la figure du buveur, la vie et les fastes de la cour.

it.name: Coppa con suonatore di *rubâb*.
description: La coppa è decorata al centro con la figura di un suonatore di rubâb, strumento a corde di tradizione iranica. Il fondo è campito con pannellature puntinate, mentre l'orlo è decorato con elementi a semicerchio. Il motivo del suonatore di rubâb, qui raffigurato seduto secondo l'abitudine dei nomadi, ricorre di frequente nell'arte islamica e sembra rievocare, al pari della figura del bevitore, scene di corte celebranti la vita del sovrano. Il musicante, raffigurato in uno stile assai simile a quello che si ritrova nella ceramica figurata di Nîshâpûr dello stesso periodo, indossa un caratteristico copricapo in uso presso i popoli turco-mongoli dell'Asia centrale.

La decorazione dell'esemplare mostra, tra gli altri elementi, una figura maschile intenta a suonare uno strumento a corde, il *rubâb*. La figura del suonatore è usuale nell'arte islamica e sembra rievocare, al pari della figura del bevitore, la vita ed i fasti della Corte.

en.name: *Amphitheatre at El Jem*
short_description: This drawing is by Sir Grenville Temple. The Amphitheatre of El Jem is seen as a symbol Roman Tunisia. Sometimes called the Colosseum of Ancient Thysdrus (El Jem), this amphiteatre is the only in the world, other than the colosseum of Rome, to have preserved all three of its tiers. Considered the most beautiful monument of ancient Africa, the Amphitheatre of El Jem was listed as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO on 26 October 1979.

fr.name: *Amphithéâtre d’El Jem*
short_description: Dessin de Sir Grenville Temple ; l’amphithéâtre d’El Jem est considéré comme la marque distinctive de la Tunisie romaine. Appelé aussi le Colisée de l’antique Thysdrus (El Jem), l’amphithéâtre est le seul de par le monde avec le Colisée de Rome à posséder encore une façade intacte à trois niveaux de galeries. Considéré comme le plus beau monument de l’Afrique antique, l’amphithéâtre d’El Jem a été classé le 26 octobre 1979 par l’Unesco sur la liste du Patrimoine mondial.
holder: Institut supérieur d’Histoire contemporaine de la Tunisie
keywords: Amphithéatre; El Jem; Colisée; Rome
partner: Institut Supérieur d’histoire contemporaine de la Tunisie, Université de la Manouba

en.name: Tumbler
description:
The glass is bell-shaped and rests on a wider, cylindrical base. It is embossed with engraved motifs. The front displays the initials "A.K." encircled by a garland. The opposite side and rim display a floral motif. An 1844 Austrian coin was placed inside the glass' stand.  
It was determined by comparison and stylistic analysis that the glass was most likely created in the first glass manufactory of the Principality of Serbia, which was owned by Avram Petronijević, the then Minister of Foreign Affairs and the envoy at the Sublime Porte. At the invitation of Avram Petronijević, glassmakers came from Bohemian and Bavarian glasshouses. Considering that the manufactory operated during a very short period, from 1846 to 1852, only a small number of items can be reliably linked to its production and few have been preserved. Most items were caste or mould blown. They are distinguished by their common characteristics: a greyish tone of glass that testifies to the presence of lead, the presence of bubbles in the glass mass, and the thick walls of the object. They were heavy, but harmonious shapes, such as this very rare example that was most likely made for a particular person.
artist: Probably Glass Manufacture of Avram Petronijevic, Serbia
keywords: Blown glass; Coin; Engraved decoration; Floral decoration; Manufacture; Serbia
materials: Colourless, blown glass with engraved decoration
tags: Colourless, blown glass with engraved decoration

en.name: *The Coffee Shop*
short_description: Coffee shops in the Near and Middle East were regular meeting places for men, who could while away hours chatting, playing domino, smoking and – crucially if dangerously – talking politics. In early 20th century Cairo as elsewhere, spedific cafes became important hubs for social and political discourse.This painting shows a traditional Near Eastern street café. Customers are sitting on long benches in front of its wooden openwork facade, A waiter with a red fez carries a brass coffee pot (dallah) and a tray. Behind him, through the wooden screen, the preparation area, in which the coffee is made, can just be seen on the left. A man wearing a white turban and blue gown, perhaps the proprietor, looks out on the right. All present are captivated by a carpet seller, who is standing in front of the cafe, offering up his wares.
holder: Sharjah Art Museum / Sharjah Museums Department
keywords: dallah

en.name: Palaces of the Toledo and Ayala Families
description:
Although the interiors of the palaces are within the enclosed area of the Convent of Santa Isabel de los Reyes, which occupies one side, the small square really deserves a visit as it is one of the most typical and representative corners of Toledo’s town plan, and an example of the continuous transformation of the medieval city. In the Islamic period the site lay in the district of the Dyers, which was still there in the 12th century, and from the 13th century was called the Old Dyers, as the workshops had been moved to the south of the city by then. Construction of the Parish Church of San Antolin probably took place around this same time. During a reconstruction at the beginning of the 16th century as the Conventual Church of the Monastery of Santa Isabel, a small Mudéjar apse was retained from the primitive church where the usual Toledo Mudéjar type is repeated, very similar to that of Cristo de la Luz.  
In the Middle Ages, the palaces of the Toledo and Ayala families – two of the most important lineages of Castile from the mid-15th century – stood beside the church. All the members of these families, in turn, built their own houses on this land, of which four still survive today. These were donated in 1488 to found the convent. Still visible in the high walls is a small doorway, dating from the end of the 14th century, which belonged to the Palace of don Pedro Suárez de Toledo y Ayala. The door’s decoration, made up of the owner’s coat of arms, emphasises the combination of arch and lintel as the Mudéjar version of the Hispano-Muslim scheme that can be traced back to the façades of the Mezquita in Córdoba. Originally, on either side, small pilasters ending in brackets with figures of lions – very mutilated now – supported wooden eaves. This formula is considered a characteristic of Toledo; a variant of the same scheme, including the window on the upper floor, is repeated in the building commonly called the Palace of Pedro I on the other side of the street, which still conserves its original wooden eaves. Although named after King Pedro I of Castile, in fact, the palace once belonged to doña Teresa de Ayala, wife of Fernán Álvarez de Toledo, Lord of Higares, as is shown by the arms over the doorway. In the nearby travesía de Santa Isabel, another palace – that of doña Inés de Ayala – was linked to the palaces already mentioned by a *cobertizo*, a gallery passageway that can still be seen at street level. Here, the patio and part of one room are preserved. Finally, next to the present entrance to the church, are the remains of the doorway of yet another of the palaces, that of doña Juana Enríquez, granddaughter of the above-mentioned Inés de Ayala, who donated the entire complex of houses to found the convent.

es.name: Palacios de los Toledo y Ayala
description:
Aunque el interior de los palacios queda recluido en la clausura del convento de Santa Isabel de los Reyes, que ocupa uno de los laterales, resulta interesante visitar esta pequeña plaza, uno de los rincones más típicos y representativos del urbanismo toledano, entendido como ejemplo de la continua transformación de la ciudad medieval. En época islámica formaba parte del barrio de los Tintoreros, que todavía en el siglo XII seguían instalados aquí, y desde el siglo XIII se denominó de los Tintes Viejos, a causa de su desplazamiento hacia el sur de la ciudad. Por esos años debió construirse la parroquia de San Antolín, reformada a comienzos del siglo XVI como iglesia conventual del monasterio de Santa Isabel, pero que aún conserva un pequeño ábside mudéjar del primitivo edificio, donde se repite el tipo habitual del mudéjar toledano, muy próximo al del Cristo de la Luz.  
A su lado se encontraban en la Edad Media los palacios de los Toledo y los Ayala, dos de los linajes más importantes de Castilla desde mediados del siglo XIV. Cada uno de los miembros de la familia iba construyendo en este solar su propia residencia, de las que todavía subsisten cuatro viviendas. Estas casas fueron donadas en 1488 para fundar el convento. Entre paredones destaca hoy la pequeña portada de fines del siglo XIV correspondiente al palacio de don Pedro Suárez de Toledo y Ayala, cuyos escudos componen la decoración resaltando la combinación de arco y dintel como versión mudéjar del esquema hispano-musulmán que se remonta a las fachadas de la mezquita de Córdoba. A cada lado, pequeñas pilastras rematadas en ménsulas con figuras de león —muy mutiladas—, sostuvieron primitivamente un alero de madera. La fórmula se considera característica del arte toledano, y una variante del mismo esquema, incluyendo la ventana del piso alto, se repite en el llamado palacio de Pedro I, al otro lado de la calle, que en este caso conserva el antiguo alero de madera. Aunque conocido por el nombre del rey Pedro I de Castilla, el palacio perteneció a doña Teresa de Ayala, casada con Fernán Álvarez de Toledo, señor de Higares, como demuestran sus escudos sobre la portada. En la inmediata travesía de Santa Isabel estuvo otro de los palacios —el de doña Inés de Ayala—, que comunicaba con los anteriores por un pasadizo en alto que todavía puede verse como cobertizo desde la calle, y del que se conservan el patio y parte de uno de los salones. Finalmente, al lado de la actual entrada a la iglesia quedan restos de la puerta de otro de los palacios, el de doña Juana Enríquez, nieta de la citada Inés de Ayala, que fue quien donó el conjunto de las casas para fundar el convento.

en.name: High altar
description: The powerful column structure of the high altar in red marble completely fills the choir’s eastern alcove. The altarpiece depicting the Transfiguration of St. Augustine is overshadowed by a large stucco statue of Mary Immaculate in front of an aureole window. In addition, the church patron is flanked by the two Johns (Evangelist and Baptist).
artist: Diego Francesco Carlone (1674–1750); Jakob Zanusi [n.d.]; Lorenz Wieser [n.d.]

en.name: *Ecce Homo*
description:
The work may have been commissioned directly from the artist by Cardinal Scipione Borghese. It is first documented in his collection in 1613. In the canvas, the story of the Passion of Christ is transformed for the viewer into a subject of meditation. Light suffuses the body of Christ in a diagonal line high-lit by the hem of the red cloak held up by the executioner. We see the regal symbols that Christ was forced to wear, the crown of thorns, the reed sceptre and the red cloak as signs of mockery and derision, with which the Gospels tell us Pontius Pilate presented his prisoner to the crowd with the words “*Ecce homo*” (“Behold the man”). Along with the column (representing flagellation), and hammer and nails, which anticipate the crucifixion, the scene is transformed from a historical account into a meditative subject designed to inspire among the faithful feelings of compassion and shared pain with the martyr. The executioner, awkward and unrefined next to the beauty of Christ's face, is placed in the darkness – both literally and spiritually – as one who does not recognise the divinity of the Son of God. The capacity to inspire reflection on the dogma of faith while simultaneously engaging the viewer emotionally is the basis of the ethos of the Counter-Reformation. Communication of feelings and affections was also fundamental to the development of Baroque art.  
In this piece, Giovanni Baglione emphasises the dramatic sense of the scene through the use of *chiaroscuro* developed by Caravaggio and his followers from their experiments undertaken in Rome in the first years of the 17th century. On the other hand, Christ's face, gazing towards the heavens in a mood of total acceptance of divine will, reflects the more delicate and idealised style of the Carracci school, in particular Guido Reni.

The theme of derision is shown in comparison with those who don’t recognise Christ as the Son of God, sent to earth to save mankind. The scene sends a very clear message against the Reformation. Although the subject is intended for meditation, its theatrical style is a prelude to the drama expressed in Baroque art.
keywords: Christian themes; Reformation; Counter-Reformation; symbolism

it.name: *Ecce Homo*
description:
L'opera fu forse commissionata all'artista direttamente dal cardinale Scipione Borghese, nella cui collezione è documentata fin dal 1613. Nella tela il racconto della passione di Cristo viene trasformato in tema di meditazione offerto allo sguardo dello spettatore. La luce investe il corpo del Cristo, secondo una linea diagonale sottolineata dal lembo del manto rosso sollevato dal carnefice. Sono visibili i simboli regali che furono fatti indossare a Gesù in segno di scherno e derisione e con i quali, secondo il racconto evangelico, Ponzio Pilato presentò il prigioniero alla folla pronunciando le parole “Ecce homo” (“Ecco l'uomo”): la corona di spine, una canna come scettro, il manto rosso. Insieme alla colonna, simbolo di flagellazione, ai chiodi e al martello, che preludono alla crocifissione, la scena si trasforma da racconto storico a tema meditativo, tale da indurre nel fedele sentimenti di pietà e dolorosa condivisione del martirio. Il carnefice, dai tratti rozzi e goffi rispetto alla bellezza del volto di Cristo, è posto nell'oscurità - materiale e spirituale – di chi non riconosce la divinità del figlio di Dio. La capacità di far riflettere sui dogmi della fede suscitando al tempo stesso la partecipazione emotiva dello spettatore è alla base del linguaggio della Controriforma; la comunicazione dei sentimenti e degli affetti sarà altresì basilare per lo sviluppo dell'arte barocca.  
Giovanni Baglione in questa opera enfatizza il senso drammaticamente teatrale della scena attraverso l'uso del chiaroscuro, desunto dalle sperimentazioni condotte a Roma nei primi anni del Seicento da Caravaggio e dai suoi seguaci. Il volto di Cristo, con lo sguardo rivolto al cielo in segno di totale accettazione della volontà divina, risente invece dello stile più morbido e idealizzato proprio dell'ambito dei Carracci e in particolare di Guido Reni.

Il tema della derisione è posto in rapporto con coloro che non riconoscono Cristo come il Figlio di Dio, inviato sulla terra per salvare l'umanità. La scena invia un messaggio molto chiaro contro la Riforma. Nonostante il soggetto fosse destinato alla meditazione, il suo stile teatrale è il preludio al dramma espresso nell'arte barocca.
keywords: Tematiche cristiane; Riforma; Controriforma; simbolismo

en.name: Damaskus (Bahnhof Kadem). (Damascus, Qadem Station)
description: The postcard records the wider landscape surrounding the Qadam Station, on the urban edge of Damascus. The spacious compound with scattered service buildings and temporary tents shows that railway stations could extend beyond their passenger facilities and logistical zones. The open terrain surrounding the station reflects Qadam's position on the southern outskirts of Damascus, where sufficient land existed for railway expansion before the line continued towards the south and the Holy Cities. The coexistence of the station with its trains and the animal transportation outside of it demonstrates that modern rail infrastructure remained closely integrated with traditional patterns of mobility and movement. As the main southern operational station, Qadam formed the transition between the densely inhabited city of Damascus and the long open journeys towards Hijaz.
keywords: Hijaz Railway; Damascus; Qadam Station; railway landscape; railway infrastructure

ar.name: حلية للصدر(لبة).
description: يتكون هذا العقد العريض من عدة جواهر منظومة ضمن بريم من الحرير، تتناوب مع لآلئ من الذهب بيضوية الشكل ومخددة؛ وتتشكل من عدة جواهر من الذهب متدلية، لها شكل زهيرات أو زهرات رودس المدعوة "غرناطي"، وورديات وأهلة ونجوم، تجتمع كلها لتشكل واقية صدر عريضة وطويلة تغطي كل الصدر تقريباً. زينت الجواهر المتدلية على الوجهين، ورصعت كل واحدة منها بعشرة زخارف على شكل مسمار مزخرف الرأس من الزمرد ومن حجر رماني اللون على أحد الوجهين، فيما زوق الوجه الثاني بمينا مفرغة خضراء وحمراء وزرقاء اللون، ذات زخارف زهرية ونباتية. وقد كان هذا النوع من الحلي خاصا بالمناسبات، إذ يقوم بحمله العروسان من الطبقة البرجوازية يوم عرسهما وبمناسبة الاحتفالات، والرموز السحرية التي يمكن أن نلحظها مخصصة لحماية المرأة من العين الحاسدة. فاستخدام الرقم 10 في رقم الأحجار الكريمة ( وهو مضاعف رقم 5، رمز اليد التي تبعد الأعمال الشريرة) والعنصران الزخرفيان، الهلال والقمر اللذان يصوران الحاجب وقزحية العين (العين التي ترى الخطر)، كلاهما من العلامات الدالة على الأهمية التي توليها النسوة للتمائم.

كان هذا العقد المكونُ من العديد من الجواهر المتدلية والمزخرفة من كلا الوجهين يُحمل من طرف الأزواج؛ ويشتمل على رموز مخصصة لحماية المرأة من العين الحاسدة: اليدان الممثلتان بالأحجار الكريمة التي يبلغ عددها عشر قطعة والمرصعة على كل ميدالية، والعين على شكل هلال ودائرة.
keywords: زخرفة هندسية؛ زخرفة زهرية؛ حلي؛ ذهب؛ أحجار كريمة؛ مينا مفرغة؛ لبة؛ حلية صدرية.

en.name: Necklace (*lebba*).
description: This large necklace consists of several pendants alternating with fluted ovoid gold pearls on a silk cord. The pendants consist of different golden drops in the shape of fleurons or roses of Rhodes known as *gharnati*, rosettes, crescent moons and stars that come together to form a long broad necklace covering almost the entire chest. The pendants are decorated on both sides, each studded with ten emeralds and garnets on one side and decorated on the other with green, red and blue champlevé enamel with floral and plant decoration. This type of jewellery was worn by brides from Fez on their wedding day and by upper-middle-class women during festivities. The magic symbols that they bear are intended to protect the women against the evil eye. The fact that there are ten precious stones (twice five, the symbol of the hand that protects from harm) and the crescent-and-moon motif, imitating an eyebrow and an iris (the eye that sees danger) indicate the importance that women placed on amulets.

This necklace, consisting of several pendants decorated on both sides, would have been worn by a bride. It includes symbols intended to protect her against bad luck: the two hands represented by the ten precious stones set in medallions, and the eye represented by the crescent and the circle.
keywords: geometric decoration; floral decoration

es.name: Collar (*lebba*).
description:
Este largo collar cuenta con varios colgantes ensartados en un cordón de seda, alternados con perlas de oro ovoides y acanaladas.  
Estos colgantes se componen de diferentes gotas de oro en forma de florones o rosas de Rodas denominadas *garnati*, de rosetas, de semilunares y de estrellas ensambladas en un diseño que cubre el pecho casi por completo.  
Las gotas de oro presentan decoración en ambas caras. Cada una está engarzada con diez cabujones de esmeraldas y de granates sobre una cara y exhibe, en la otra, esmaltes burilados verdes, rojos y azules con diseños florales y vegetales.  
Este tipo de adorno lo lucían las novias de Fez el día de su enlace y las mujeres de la alta burguesía durante las celebraciones. Los símbolos mágicos que se pueden apreciar tienen como misión la protección de la mujer contra el mal de ojo. El empleo del diez en el número de piedras preciosas (el doble de cinco, símbolo de la mano que aleja los maleficios), junto con el semilunar y la luna imitando la imagen de una ceja y un iris (ojo que ve el peligro), revelan la importancia que las mujeres concedían a los amuletos.

Este collar compuesto por varios colgantes decorados por ambas caras era un adorno de las novias. Consta de símbolos destinados a proteger a la mujer contra la mala suerte: dos manos, representadas por el número diez de las piedras preciosas engastadas en cada medallón, y un ojo, formado por la media luna y el círculo.
dates: Siglo XIII de la Hégira /XVIII d. C.

fr.name: Parure pectorale (lebba).
description: Ce large collier est formé de plusieurs pendentifs enfilés sur un cordonnet de soie, alternés de perles d'or ovoïdes et cannelées. Ces pendentifs sont constitués de différentes pendeloques d'or en forme de fleurons ou roses de Rhodes appelées *gharnati*, de rosaces, de croissants et d'étoiles qui s'assemblent pour composer un long et large pectoral recouvrant presque toute la poitrine. Les pendeloques sont décorées sur les deux faces. Chacune d'elles est sertie de dix cabochons d'émeraudes et de grenats sur une face et rehaussée, sur l'autre, d'émaux champlevés verts, rouges et bleus aux décors floraux et végétaux. Ce type de parure était arboré par les mariées de Fès le jour de leurs noces et par les femmes de la haute bourgeoisie à l'occasion de festivités. Les symboles magiques qu'on peut y observer sont destinés à protéger la femme contre le mauvais œil. L'utilisation du chiffre dix dans le nombre de pierreries (double de cinq, symbole de la main qui éloigne les méfaits) et le motif croissant et lune, imitant l'image d'un sourcil et d'un iris (œil qui voit le danger) sont révélateurs de l'importance accordée par la femme aux amulettes.

Ce collier formé de plusieurs pendants décorés sur les deux faces était porté par les mariées. Il comporte des symboles destinés à protéger la femme contre le mauvais sort : les deux mains représentées par le nombre dix des pierres précieuses serties sur chaque médaillon, et l'œil par le motif du croissant et du cercle.
dates: XIIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIXe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: décoration géométrique ; décoration florale

ar.name: علبة خاصة بمسحوق البارود (قرعة البارود).
description:
شَكْلُ هذه العلبة، المصنوعة من الخشب المغلف بالمخمل الأحمر اللون، مقوس جداً، ولها عروتان للتعليق، تسمحان بمرور حمالة مربوطة إلى حزام الفارس أو معلقة إلى رقبته. جرى تلبيس فتحة العلبة ونهايتها ووسطها بصفائح أسطوانية أو مخروطية الشكل، من الفضة المذهبة والمخرمة والمنقوشة. وتغلب على التزيينات، سواء المطرزة بخيوط الذهب فوق مخمل التغليف، أو المنقوشة والمخرمة فوق الصفائح الفضية، الزخرفةُ النباتية مثل السيقان والغصينات والسعيفات النخيلية والزهيرات، المستوحاة من السجل الفني التقليدي المغربي - الأندلسي. في حين، تشكل النجمة ذات الثماني رؤوس، التي تطبع مركز الصفيحة المعدنية المتواجدة في الوسط ، العنصر الزخرفي الهندسي الوحيد بين هذه التزيينات النباتية.  
  
يحتوي هذا الطراز من العلب، الذي يشبه تقوسها شكل الخناجر اليمنية (الجنابية)، على البارود المعد لتعبئة بنادق ألعاب الفروسية، كما كان يشكل جزءا من لوازم الفرسان في شمال المغرب، الذين كانوا يشاركون في هذه الألعاب بخيول كانت تسرج بفخامة.

إن هذا النوع من علب البارود التي يذكر شكلها بتقوسات الخناجر اليمنية، الجنابية، كان يحوي البارود المخصص لتعبئة بنادق ألعاب الفروسية؛ وكانت العلب تشكل جزءا من لوازم فرسان شمال المغرب الذين كانوا يشاركون في هذه الألعاب بخيول تسرج بطريقة فخمة.
keywords: عتاد حربي؛ زخرفة زهرية؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ بارود؛ فروسية، فضة مذهبة ومخرمة ومنقوشة.
materials: خشب، فضة مرصعة ومخرمة ومذهبة، مخمل مطرز بخيط من الذهب.
tags: خشب، فضة مرصعة ومخرمة ومذهبة، مخمل مطرز بخيط من الذهب.

en.name: Powder container.
description:
This very curved horn-shaped container is made of wood covered with red velvet. It was fitted with two rings that enabled it to be attached to a rider's neck or waist with a strap. The mouth, tip and centre are decorated with cylindrical and conical plaques in gilded, engraved silver openwork. Whether embroidered with gold thread on the velvet covering or engraved and rendered in openwork on the silver plaques, the decoration consists mainly of plant motifs: stems, foliage, palms and fleurons borrowed from the traditional artistic repertoire of Morocco and Andalusia. A single geometric element, an eight-pointed star that marks the centre of the central metal plaque, stands alone among the plant decoration.  
This type of container, whose curving shape is reminiscent of the Yemen *jambiya* dagger, contained the powder used to load the rifles used in the *fantasia* and was part of the equipment carried by the horsemen of the north of Morocco who took part in games on richly harnessed steeds.

Powder horns of this type, whose shape is reminiscent of the curve of the Yemeni *jambia* dagger, carried the powder used to load the rifles used in *fantasias*. They were carried by the horsemen of Northern Morocco who participated in such games on sumptuously harnessed horses.
keywords: arms; armours; floral decoration; geometric decoration; military object; military wear; war; warfare
materials: Wood; engraved, gilded silver openwork; gold-embroidered velvet.

es.name: Recipiente para pólvora.
description:
Esta caja en forma de cuerno muy curvado es de madera enfundada en terciopelo rojo.  
Originalmente tenía dos anillas que servían para pasar una bandolera ajustada a la cintura o al cuello del jinete.  
Unas placas cilíndricas y cónicas de plata dorada, calada y cincelada revisten la apertura, los extremos y el centro.  
Los adornos están bordados en hilo de oro sobre el terciopelo de la funda o cincelados y calados en las placas de plata. Predominan los motivos florales: tallos, ramajes, palmas y florones inspirados en el repertorio del arte tradicional marroquí-andalusí. Como excepción a esta ornamentación vegetal, aparece un único elemento geométrico: la estrella de ocho puntas grabada en el centro de la placa metálica central.  
Este cuerno, cuya curvatura evoca la forma de los puñales yemeníes o *yenbias*, contenía la pólvora destinado a cargar los fusiles de fantasía y formaba parte de los pertrechos de los jinetes del norte de Marruecos que participaban en esos festivales con caballos suntuosamente enjaezados.

Los recipientes de este tipo, cuya forma evoca la curvatura de los puñales yemeníes, los *yenbias*, contenían la pólvora destinado a cargar fusiles de fantasía. Formaban parte de los pertrechos de los jinetes del norte de Marruecos que participaban en festivales con caballos suntuosamente enjaezados.
dates: Siglo XIV de la Hégira/XIX d. C.
materials: Madera, plata, terciopelo; cincelado, calado, dorado, bordado en hilo de oro.
tags: cincelado, calado, dorado, bordado en hilo de oro.

fr.name: Boîte à poudre.
description:
Cette boîte en forme de corne très recourbée est en bois gainé de velours rouge. Elle était munie de deux anses de suspension qui permettaient de passer une bandoulière accrochée à la ceinture ou au cou du cavalier. L'ouverture, l'extrémité et le centre sont revêtus de plaques cylindriques et coniques en argent doré, ajouré et ciselé. Brodés en fils d'or sur le velours de la gaine ou ciselés et ajourés sur les plaques d'argent, les ornements sont en majorité à décor végétal : tiges, rinceaux, palmes et fleurons empruntés au répertoire de l'art traditionnel maroco-andalou. Un seul élément géométrique – l'étoile à huit branches qui timbre le centre de la plaque métallique du milieu – fait exception dans cette ornementation végétale.  
  
Ce type de boîte, dont la courbure rappelle la forme des poignards yéménites *djenbias*, contenait le pulvérin destiné à charger les fusils de la fantasia et faisait partie de l'attirail des cavaliers du nord du Maroc qui participaient à ces jeux avec des chevaux richement harnachés.

Les poudrières de ce type, dont la forme rappelle la courbure des poignards yéménites *djenbias*,contenaient le pulvérin destiné à charger les fusils de la fantasia. Elles faisaient partie de l'attirail des cavaliers du nord du Maroc qui participaient à ces jeux avec des chevaux richement harnachés.
dates: XIIIe-XIVe siècle de l'Hégire (XIXe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: armement ; décoration florale et géométrique
materials: Bois, argent ciselé, ajouré et doré, velours brodé au fil d’or.
tags: Bois, argent ciselé, ajouré et doré, velours brodé au fil d’or.

en.name: Pendant for horses – Type 1
short_description: This pendant was used on the horses of Ottoman officials and indicated their high status and wealth. It is made of a single, lozenge-shaped silver plaque decorated with red coral and blue gemstones. Silver leaf-shaped pendants dangle from this plaque and produce a tinkling noise when moving, announcing the arrival of the rider.
keywords: Decoration; Silver; Jewels; Precious stones

en.name: Moto Guzzi 1100 Sport Corsa
description: The Moto Guzzi 1100 Sport Corsa, a limited edition of only 200 units, is a high-performance sport motorcycle from 1998. Equipped with a powerful V-twin engine and Weber-Marelli electronic fuel injection, this motorcycle stands out for its innovative technology. The chrome-molybdenum steel frame, with the engine as a stressed member, contributes to its sporty character and makes it a prized possession for collectors.
keywords: Sportbike; Italian; carbon fiber; high-performance engine

en.name: *The Grand Bazaar*
short_description: Amadeo Preziosi often presented genre scenes from Istanbul in his unique style. Specifically, he incorporated diverse scenes from the Bazaar in a number of his paintings. This venue, particular to Istanbul, has been of great interest to western artists, and in Edmondo De Amicis’s words “is not just a building but a town”. The Grand Bazaar, which housed shops for a wide range of commercial goods and catered to almost all of the needs of customers, offered an incredible visual richness and diversity to the western artist. A reflection of this opulence is also evident in Preziosi’s painting, which includes numerous details from daily life.
keywords: Amadeo Preziosi; Orientalism; painting; İstanbul

ar.name: غطاء وسادة.
description: غطاء وسادة مستطيل الشكل مشغول يدوياً، ربما كان يستخدم لحماية الأرائك أو الدواوين الخفيضة في القصور العثمانية منذ القرن العاشر / السادس عشر فصاعداً. وهذا الغطاء مصنوع من المخمل الصافي ذي اللون القرمزي ( وهي تقنية تعتمد قص الزئبر بشكل قصير كي تسمح برؤية لون الحقل ومشهده) ومنسوج بخيوط خضراء وصفراء شاحبة. يعتبر هذا الأسلوب نمطياً في تلك الفترة: أرضية مركزية ونطاقان على شكل قناطر ورصيعة نباتية مدوَّرة وكبيرة تملأ الأرضية في هذا النموذج. وبعد أن ينجز النساج الغطاء، لا يفصله عن النول، وإنما يقحم عصا خشبية بين السداة واللحمة، ثم يباشر عمله على الغطاء التالي.

غطاء الوسادة هذا، مصنوع من المخمل الأحمر القرمزي المُفرَّغ، حيث أجزاء من الحاشية مبتورة عن قرب شديد، بما أدَّى إلى بقاء بنية اللُّحمة والسدى وألوانهما مكشوفة، مُتمخِّضة عن قالب نباتي متقن. هذا النمط من المخمل كان مطلوباً في الدولة العثمانية وخارجها.
keywords: حريم؛ حياة البلاط؛ زخرفة نباتية.

en.name: Cushion cover.
description: A hand-woven cushion cover of rectangular form that would have been used to back the low divans or sofas in Ottoman palaces from the AH 10th / AD 16th century onwards. The cushion is made of crimson-red voided velvet (a technique whereby the pile is cropped so short that the structure and colour of the field can be seen), and woven with green and cream threads. The composition is typical of the period, with a central field and two arched boarders; a large floral medallion fills the central field in this example. Having completed such a cover, the weaver did not cut it off the loom, but inserted a wooden baton between the Warp and the weft, and began on the next cover.

This cushion cover is made of a crimson-red voided velvet, where parts of its pile have been cropped very short so that the structure and colours of the warp and weft are exposed, creating an elaborate floral pattern. This type of velvet was sought after both within the Ottoman Empire and beyond.
keywords: Court life; the harem; floral decoration

es.name: Funda de cojín.
description: Funda tejida a mano para un cojín que serviría de respaldo en divanes bajos o sofás de palacios otomanos del siglo X / XVI y posteriores. Es de terciopelo carmesí cortado (el pelo de deja tan corto que se aprecian la trama y el color de fondo) tejido con hilos verdes y crema. La composición es típica de este periodo: un campo central con un medallón con decoración floral y dos franjas con arquerías. Una vez terminada la pieza, el tejedor, en vez de cortarla del telar, colocaba una varilla entre la urdimbre y la trama y comenzaba a una nueva funda.

Funda de cojín en terciopelo carmesí cortado. Esta técnica consiste en dejar el pelo tan corto que permita apreciar la trama y el color de fondo, formando aquí un refinado motivo floral. Este tipo de terciopelo era muy solicitado tanto dentro como fuera del Imperio Otomano.
dates: Siglo XI de la Hégira / XVII d. C.
keywords: vida cortesana; harén; decoración floral
materials: Terciopelo de seda tejido a mano.
tags: Terciopelo de seda tejido a mano.

fr.name: Housse de coussin.
description: Housse en soie tissée à la main de forme rectangulaire, sans doute utilisée sur les coussins des divans ou sofas des palais ottomans à partir du Xe siècle H (XVIe siècle J.-C.). Elle est en velours rouge cramoisi ciselé (technique dans laquelle le poil est coupé si court que la structure et la couleur du fond apparaissent), tissé de fils verts et crème. La composition met en scène un champ central occupé par un grand médaillon entouré de deux larges bordures en arc. Son travail achevé, le tisserand ne l'a pas détaché de son métier mais a inséré un bâtonnet de bois entre la trame et la chaîne avant de commencer la housse suivante.

Cette housse de coussin est fabriquée dans un velours rouge cramoisi dont certaines parties des fils ont été coupés si court que la structure et la couleur de la chaîne et de la trame apparaissent, créant un motif floral sophistiqué. Ce type de velours était recherché tant à l’intérieur de l’Empire ottoman qu’au-delà.
dates: XIe siècle de l’Hégire (XVIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: vie de cour ; harem ; décoration florale
materials: Velours de soie tissé à la main.

en.name: Vessel
description: The vessel is cream-coloured, with a ring base, convex body, long thin neck and scalloped rim. The figural, stylised geometric and floral decorations in a lustre technique cover the entire surface.

en.name: Sidi al-Mandri Kasbah
description:
This Mediaeval monument was rebuilt in the 9th/15th century by Sidi al-Mandri from Granada. This warrior, who made his name in the army of Ibn al-Ahmar, employed Christians, captured during his campaigns against Ceuta, to build this monumental *kasbah*. The centre of government and of the military, the *kasbah* is situated in the south-west of the primary enclosure of the town. Only the external walls and bastions remain of the original fortress.  
The south-west facade of the *kasbah*, the best preserved side, has three forts which are linked to one another by a covered passageway. Alcoves, hollowed out of the thick gates, sheltered the sentinels. The gates, of vaults made out of brick, are similar to those of the *kasbah* in Granada.  
A mosque, rebuilt in the 11th/17th and 12th/18th centuries rose up inside the building. The dwellings of Sidi al-Mandri were not far from the mosque. Nothing but the *hammam* of this modest living space remains, which was the private bath attached to the house, consistingof two domes surmounted by fan-vaulting.

es.name: Alcazaba Sidi al-Mandri
description:
Este monumento de la época medieval fue reconstruido en el siglo IX/XV por el granadino Sidi al-Mandri. Para ello, este guerrero, que se había distinguido en el ejército de Ibn al-Ahmar, empleó a los cristianos capturados en sus expediciones contra Ceuta (Sebta). La alcazaba, centro gubernamental y militar, está situada al sudoeste del primer recinto de la ciudad; de la fortaleza inicial no quedan más que los muros exteriores y los torreones.  
La fachada sudoeste es la mejor conservada; presenta tres fuertes unidos entre sí por un camino de ronda. Excavados en el espesor de las puertas hay unos nichos para los centinelas. Las puertas, con bóvedas de ladrillo, son comparables a la de la alcazaba de Granada.  
En el interior del edificio se alza una mezquita reconstruida en los siglos XI/XVII y XII/XVIII; no lejos de ella estaba la casa de Sidi al-Mandri. De esta modesta construcción de estilo tradicional solamente queda hoy el *hammam*, baño privado adosado al edificio, que comprende dos cúpulas que coronan bóvedas en abanico.

fr.name: Casbah Sidi al-Mandri
description:
Ce monument d’époque médiévale a été reconstruit au IXe/XVe siècle par le Grenadin Sidi al-Mandri. Ce guerrier, qui s’était distingué dans l’armée d’Ibn al-Ahmar, employa des chrétiens capturés lors de ses expéditions contre *Sebta* (Ceuta) pour bâtir cette monumentale casbah. Centre gouvernemental et militaire, la casbah est située au sud-ouest de la première enceinte de la ville. De la forteresse initiale, il ne reste que les murs extérieurs et les bastions.  
La façade sud-ouest de la casbah, la mieux conservée, présente trois forts reliés entre eux par un chemin de ronde. Creusées dans l’épaisseur des portes, des niches abritaient les sentinelles. Les portes, aux voûtes construites en briques, sont comparables à celles de la casbah de Grenade.  
À l’intérieur du bâtiment, s’élevait une mosquée reconstruite aux XIe/XVIIe et XIIe/XVIIIe siècles. Non loin de la mosquée se trouvait la demeure de Sidi al-Mandri. De cette modeste habitation de style traditionnel, il ne reste aujourd’hui que le *hammam*, bain privé accolé à la demeure, qui comprend deux dômes surmontant des voûtes en éventail.

ar.name: خاتم يوضع في الإبهام
description: ارتدى رماة السهام خواتم  مصنوعة من حجر شبه كريم في أصابع إبهامهم لليد اليمنى لمساعدتهم في الرمي بأقواسهم. والجزء  الجوهري من السلاح يحمل بعزة عالية في الشرق وهذه الخواتم المترفة التي كانت توضع في إبهام اليد كانت تعبيرات مثالية عن مرتبة المقاتل وثروته.

de.name: Bogenring
description: Diese Ringe aus Halbedelstein waren jeweils für den Daumen der rechten Hand des Bogenschützen bestimmt und dienten als Hilfsmittel zum Spannen der Bogensehne. Als wesentlicher Teil einer Waffe, die im Orient hohes Ansehen besaß, sind solche reich verzierten Daumenringe ideale Elemente zur Selbstdarstellung des Kriegers.

en.name: Thumb ring
description: Archers wore thumb rings made of semi-precious stone on the thumb of their right hand to help them draw their bows. A seminal part of a weapon held in high esteem in the Orient, these richly-embellished thumb rings were ideal expressions of a warrior’s status and wealth.

ar.name: قوارير ماء زمزم مختومة من البورسلين صينية باللون الأزرق والأبيض
description: يقع بئر زمزم تقريبا على عمق 30 مترا  ويبعد نحو 20 مترا شرق الكعبة وينبع من وادي إبراهيم. ومن المعروف أن النبي كان يشرب من البئر ويستخدم ماءه لأغراض مهمة . والحديث الأكثر شهرة المتعلق بزمزم يقول أن "" زمزم لما شرب له "" . وبالتالي مع الزمن تم استخدام الماء للعديد من الأغراض : في القبور وتفادي الأذى ولشفاء الأمراض وفي مناسبات للحصول على البركة.الأمثلة المشابهة لهذه القوارير هي في قصر توبكابي في إسطنبول وقد استخدمت خلال مناسبات تتضمن خلعة النبي . وخلال هذه المناسبات فقد تم تغطيس الخلعة بماء زمزم وما كان يقطر من اللباس كان يجمع في قوارير مشابهة لهذه. والأنواع المماثلة الأخرى كانت ترسل ببساطة من مكة إلى إسطنبول وتحتوي ماء زمزم وتغلق بالجلد وتخاط وتختم بالشمع. ويعتقد ان البئر قد اكتشف من قبل هاجر وإسماعيل بعد أن تركا من قبل إبراهيم في مكة. وقد أعيد اكتشافه لاحقا من قبل عبد المطلب جد النبي محمد والذي يعتقد أنه حفر آبارا عديدة أهمها زمزم. ومن ذلك الحين فإن مسؤولية تأمين الماء للحجاج بقيت على عاتق أحد أبنائه. والماء من بئر زمزم كان يجمع سابقا في دلاء بواسطة آلية مكونة من حبل وبكرة وبعدها ينقل إلى أوعية فخارية .والآن يدار البئر كليا تحت الأرض من قبل مضخات كهربائية وينتج مصنع الملك عبد الله مياه زمزم بمعدل 200,000 قارورة من الماء يوميا.

en.name: Two Chinese blue-and-white porcelain sealed ‘Zamzam’ water bottles
description:
Prophet was known to drink from the well and use the water for significant purposes. The most famous *hadith* (Prophetic saying) regarding Zamzam states that the water is good for whatever purpose it is intended. Thus, over time, the water has been used for many purposes: in graves, to prevent harm, to cure and in ceremonies to obtain blessings.  
Similar examples to these bottles are in the Topkapi Palace in Istanbul and were used during ceremonies involving the mantle of the Prophet. During these ceremonies the mantle was dipped in Zamzam water and what dripped from the cloth was then collected in bottles similar to these. Other comparable types were simply sent from Mecca to Istanbul containing Zamzam water and closed with leather, string and sealed with wax.  
The well is believed to have been discovered by Hagar and Ismael, after being abandoned by Abraham in Mecca. It was later rediscovered by ‘Abd al-Muttalib, Prophet Muhammad’s grandfather, who is credited with having dug several wells, most importantly that of Zamzam. From then on the responsibility of giving water to pilgrims was to remain in the lineage of one of his sons.  
Water from the well of Zamzam was previously collected in buckets by a rope pulley mechanism and then transferred to earthenware vessels. Now the well is entirely managed subterraneously by electric pumps and the King Abdullah Zamzam Water Factory produces approximately 200,000 bottles of water a day.
holder: Khalili Family Trust – Hajj and the Arts of Pilgrimage Collection
keywords: Blue-and-white; China; Hijaz; Holy place; Ka'ba; Medina; Mosque; Pilgrimage; Pilgrim Flask; Prayer; Prophet Muhammad; Religion; Water; Mecca
partner: Khalili Family Trust – Hajj and the Arts of Pilgrimage Collection

en.name: *Construction of a dam at Noisiel. State of the works on the 5th of August 1885*
short_description: Although little-known today, Auguste Hippolyte Collard (1812–1880s) contributed significantly to the rise of photography in France. He chose to specialise professionally in the photography of important construction sites. Thanks to him, today we can reconstruct the building of, for example, the Marne Dam at Noisiel in 1885. This dam is associated with the famous chocolatier Menier who became a pioneer in the field of cocoa refining, introducing the use of water power, among other new methods for the refinement of cocoa.
artist: Photographer: Deraine and Auguste Hippolyte Collard
keywords: Irrigation; dams; Egypt

fr.name: *Construction d'un barrage à Noisiel. Etat des travaux au 5 août 1885*
short_description: Peu connu aujourd’hui, Auguste Hippolyte Collard (1812-188.?) a pourtant participé activement à l’essor de la photographie en France. Pour subsister, il a choisi une spécialisation qui consistait à prendre des photographies de chantiers de construction importants. Grâce à lui, on peut donc reconstituer par exemple la construction d’un barrage sur la Marne à Noisiel en 1885. Ce barrage est associé à la célèbre chocolaterie Menier qui, pionnière dans la technique de la transformation du cacao, a multiplié les améliorations techniques, ici l’utilisation de la force de l’eau.
artist: Photographe: Deraine and Auguste Hippolyte Collard
keywords: Irrigation; barrages; France

en.name: Andalusian Quarter
description:
The Rif Andalusian Quarter, built to house the second wave of Andalusian refugees who came after 897/1492, was erected outside the town’s initial enclosure. Its general lay-out, whilst being similar to that of the Suiqa Quarter in terms of size and aesthetic, displays several differences forced upon it by the sharp decline of the land. The interiors of houses were, in the majority of cases, built across two or three levels, in the same way as the interiors of houses that have two entrances, which allow entry into the house via the first or via the second floor. The streets, over which the supporting walls lean, are crowded with staircases and rocks which are used as buttresses.  
In addition, the appearance of the gates of the houses is well looked after; the doors, made of wood, and the stucco used in the portals, are treated with care.

es.name: Barrio al-Andalus
description: El barrio Rif al-Andalus se creó para recibir la segunda oleada de andalusíes que vinieron después de 897/1492. Se construyó fuera del primer recinto. La organización de los espacios, aunque semejante a la del barrio Suiqa en lo que concierne a las grandes líneas y a la concepción estética, presenta algunas diferencias, obligadas por la fuerte pendiente del terreno. El interior de las casas ha sido realizado, en la mayoría de los casos, en dos o tres niveles, de manera que puede haber dos entradas opuestas y el acceso puede efectuarse por la primera o la segunda planta. Las calles, en las que sobresalen los muros de contención, están salpicadas de tramos de escaleras y de rocas utilizadas como contrafuertes. El aspecto de las puertas de las casas está muy cuidado, al igual que el tratamiento de las hojas de madera y el estuco de los portales.

fr.name: Quartier al-Andalus
description:
Le quartier Rif al-Andalous, créé pour recevoir la deuxième vague de réfugiés andalous venus après 897/1492, s’est construit à l’extérieur de la première enceinte de la ville. Son plan général, tout en étant semblable à celui du quartier Souika dans ses grandes lignes et sa conception esthétique, présente quelques différences, imposées par la forte déclivité du terrain. L’intérieur des maisons a été bâti, dans la majorité des cas, sur deux niveaux ou trois, de sorte que l’on peut trouver dans une même maison deux entrées opposées, et l’accès peut se faire par le premier ou le deuxième étage. Les rues, où les murs de soutènement ressortent en saillie, sont ponctuées de rampes d’escaliers et de rochers utilisés comme contrefort.  
L’aspect des portes des maisons est également soigné, ainsi que le traitement des vantaux en bois, et le stuc des portails.

en.name: Nossa Senhora da Anunciação (Parish church, a former mosque)
names: Parish Church of Nossa Senhora da Anunciação (a former mosque)
description:
The Mértola mosque was built in the mid-6th/12th century on a site previously occupied by another religious building.  
The structure of Mértola’s Congregational Mosque remained largely unaltered until the beginning of the 16th century, when it was drawn by Duarte d’Armas, who refers to it as the “church which was once a mosque”. This precious drawing depicts a temple with five naves (each of which has a pitched roof) and it is also possible to recognise the minaret, which the Christian Lords had adapted to form a bell-tower. The building’s progressive degradation led to major repair work being undertaken in the first half of the 16th century. Financed by D. João de Mascarenhas and carried out around 1530, these building works were to significantly alter the building’s volumetry. In particular, the roof was vaulted, which meant increasing the height of the walls and building powerful buttresses.  
After these successive alterations and restoration work, what now remains of the Mértola Mosque are the outer walls and four small doors (three of them opening onto the former courtyard and one leading to the outside) where the slightly stilted horseshoe arch is framed by an *alfiz*. Inside the church it is possible to identify the polygonal *mihrab*, which still contains its stuccoed decoration, but now without the polychrome effects. There are three multi-lobed blind arches, above it, a cornice framed by two cordons, expressing the idea of infinity, a theme that is repeated at the top of the moulding.  
Even though the exoticism of its interior may be misleading, the rest of the building reflects the building work undertaken in the 16th century or even later.  
Mértola’s present-day Parish Church has been classified as a National Monument since 1910.

es.name: Iglesia mayor de Nossa Senhora da Anunciação (antigua mezquita)
description:
La mezquita de Mértola fue construida a mediados del siglo VI/m. XII, en un lugar antes ocupado por otro edificio de carácter religioso.  
La estructura de la *aljama* de Mértola se mantuvo sin grandes alteraciones hasta principios del siglo XVI, cuando Duarte D’Armas la dibujó, escribiendo en la leyenda “iglesia que fue mezquita”. En ese precioso registro iconográfico aparece representado un templo con cinco naves (cada una con un tejado a dos aguas), y se reconoce incluso el alminar, que los caballeros cristianos adaptaron a torre de campanario. La progresiva degradación del edificio obligó, en la primera mitad del siglo XVI, a la realización de obras en profundidad. Los trabajos efectuados hacia 1530 y pagados por Juan de Mascarenhas alteraron de forma significativa los volúmenes del edificio. Hay que señalar, en particular, el abovedamiento del techo, que obligó a elevar los muros y construir poderosos contrafuertes. De la mezquita de Mértola, después de las sucesivas obras y restauraciones, han llegado hasta nosotros los muros exteriores y cuatro pequeñas puertas (tres abiertas al antiguo patio y otra al exterior) en que el arco de herradura, levemente peraltado, está enmarcado por un alfiz. En el interior se identifican aún el *mihrab*, de planta poligonal y que ostenta todavía su decoración de escayola, con tres arcos ciegos polilobulados coronados por una moldura cimera con dos cordones sin fin, tema que se repite en lo alto del conjunto. El resto del edificio, aunque el exotismo de su interior pueda inducir a error, pertenece a las obras del siglo XVI o a las que tuvieron lugar posteriormente.  
La actual iglesia mayor de Mértola está catalogada como Monumento Nacional desde 1910.

ar.name: طارقة باب.
description:
هذه القطعة عبارة عن طارقة باب للمدرسة الشاذبختية التي أقيمت في مدينة حلب في عهد الملك الظاهر غازي، وقد أمر بإقامتها شاذبخت وهو عتيق (عبد أخذ حريته) الملك العادل نور الدين محمود بن زنكي (حكم في الفترة 541-569 / 1146-1174).  
  
الطارقة عبارة عن حلقة معدنية برونزية على شكل وردة لها ستة أنصاف دوائر بينها زوايا صغيرة، مزوّدة في أعلاها بما يشبه المسمار يثبَّت في الباب. وعلى هذه الحلقة، هناك نقش بخط الثلث سهل القراءة نصه: "في أيام الملك الظاهر الفقير إلى رحمة الله شاذبخت عتيق الملك العادل نور الدين رحمة الله عليهم." وهناك بعض الزخارف النباتية البسيطة بين الكلمات.  
  
كان التعليم في العصور الإسلامية الأولى مرتبطاً بالمساجد، وهو كذلك إلى اليوم إلى حدّ ما. ولكن العصور السلجوقية والأتابكية والأيوبية شهدت ازدهاراً في الأبنية المخصصة للتعليم الديني والمذهبي، وعُرِفت تلك الأبنية بالمدارس.
قارعة باب، على شكل زهرة، والتي كانت مُعلَّقة على بوابة مدرسة الشاذبختية في حلب. نُقش عليها اسم صاحب المشغل الذي تمَّ فيه الصنع، والذي كان واضحاً، وأنيقاً جداً.
place: ربما تكون قد صُنعت في حلب.
keywords: باب؛ برونز؛ برونز مصبوب بالقالب؛ حلب؛ خط الثلث؛ صناعة معدنية؛ مدرسة.

en.name: Door knocker.
description:
A door knocker that belonged to the Madrasa al-Shadhbakhtiyya in Aleppo, commissioned by the Ayyubid ruler al-Malik al-Zahir Ghazi (r. AH 582–613 / AD 1186–1216). The school was named after Shadhbakht, an '*atiq*, or freed slave, of al-Malik al-‘Adil Nur al-Din Mahmud bin Zangi (r. AH 541–69 / AD 1146–74).  
The door knocker is a bronze flower-shaped ring that takes the form of six semi-circles with intermitting small protrusions. At the top of the knocker is a bolt that would have been used to attach it to the door. Along the body of the knocker is an easily legible Arabic inscription in *thuluth* script that reads: “In the days of al-Malik al-Zahir, who begs for the mercy of God, Shadhbakht the freed slave of al-Malik al-‘Adil Nur al-Din, may God have mercy upon them.” Some simple decorative vegetal motifs are located between the words of the inscription.  
Education in the early Islamic period took place in the mosques, and much of religious education continues to do so. Nevertheless, the Seljuq, Atabeg and Ayyubid periods witnessed a flourishing of specialised education centres dedicated to the study of theology and legal issues. These were known as *madrasas*.
A flower-shaped door knocker that was once attached to the gate of the Madrasa Shadhbakhtiyya in Aleppo is inscribed with the patron's name in an easily legible and finely decorated script.
keywords: Bronze; door knocker; metalwork; thuluth; madrasa; al-Malik al-Zahir Ghazi; al-Malik al-‘Adil Nur al-Din; Aleppo

es.name: Aldaba.
description:
Esta aldaba perteneció a la madrasa de al-Shadbajtiyya de Alepo, construida por orden del gobernante ayyubí a-Malik al-Zahir Giyaz al-Din Gazi (r. 582-613 / 1186-1216). La escuela recibió el nombre de Shadbajt en honor de un *atiq* (“liberto”) de al-Malik al-Adil Nur al-Din Mahmud ibn Zangi (r. 541-569 / 1146-1174).  
La aldaba, de bronce, es una anilla con forma de flor que consta de seis semicírculos con pequeños salientes en las intersecciones exteriores. En la parte superior se ve el perno para fijarla a la puerta. El cuerpo de la aldaba presenta una inscripción en letra *zuluz* claramente legible que dice: “En tiempos de al-Malik al-Zahir, que implora la gracia de Dios, Shadbajt el liberto de al-Malik al-Adil Nur al-Din, que Dios tenga piedad de ellos”. Entre las letras hay sencillos motivos vegetales decorativos.  
En las primeras etapas de la era islámica, la educación se impartía en las mezquitas, costumbre que sigue vigente hoy día en la educación religiosa. No obstante, en las épocas selyuqí, atabeg y ayyubí proliferó la creación de madrasas, centros educativos especializados en el estudio de temas teológicos y legales.
Esta aldaba con forma de flor perteneció a la puerta de la madrasa Shadbajtiyya de Alepo y lleva inscrito el nombre del patrocinador en letra claramente legible y exquisitamente decorada.
keywords: Bronce; aldaba; talla en piedra; metalistería; escritura cúfica; madrasa; al-Malik al-Zahir Gazi; al-Malik al-‘Adil Nur al-Din; Alepo.

fr.name: Heurtoir.
description:
Heurtoir venant de la *madrasa* al-Shadhbakhtiyya d'Alep, commanditée par le souverain ayyoubide al-Malik al-Dahir Ghazi (r. 582-613 H / 1186-1216 J.-C.). L'école portait le nom de Shadhbakht, *‘atiq*, ou esclave émancipé, d'al-Malik al-‘Adil Nour al-Din Mahmoud bin Zangi (r. 541-569 H / 1146-1174 J.-C.).  
Le heurtoir se présente sous la forme d'un anneau de bronze à profil de fleur à six lobes. En partie supérieure, figure encore le système d'attache à la porte. Une inscription arabe en style *thoulouth* court sur le plat de l'objet : "Au temps d'al-Malik al-Dahir, qui prie Dieu de le prendre en pitié, Shadhbakht l'esclave libéré d'al-Malik al‘Adil Nour al-Din, que Dieu ait pitié d'eux." Quelques motifs végétaux simples ont été répartis entre les mots.  
Au début de la période islamique, l'éducation s'effectuait dans les mosquées, ce qui est toujours le cas pour l'instruction religieuse. Néanmoins, les périodes seldjoukide, atabeg et ayyoubide virent l'apparition de nombreux centres d'éducation spécialisée consacrés à l'étude de la théologie et de diverses matières juridiques, les *madrasa*.
Heurtoir en forme de fleur ayant appartenu à la porte de la *madrasa* al-Shadhbakhtiyya à Alep et orné du nom de son commanditaire dans une écriture aisément lisible et finement ornementée.
keywords: Bronze ; heurtoir ; travail du métal ; écriture thoulouth; madrasa ; al-Malik al-Dahir Ghazi ; al-Malik al-‘Adil Nour al-Din ; Alep

en.name: Cadillac Series 62 Convertible
description:
General Motors constructed this convertible in the 1950s known as the “Decade of Innocence.” Extreme length, width and low suspensions define cars of this era, cultivating a novel extravagance in the industry.  
  
This white Cadillac sedan accentuates its excessive chrome, all-red leather interiors, and a removable soft-top.  
  
During the blockade of Qatar in 2017, political tensions deeply affected many families and individuals. However, sentiments of community, togetherness, and unity prevailed. The FBQ Museum invited visitors from across the world to write messages of hope and encouragement on this Cadillac. Moving past the blockade, this initiative will reflect this era of resilience of Qatar beyond time.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani
keywords: Convertible; Two-Door; Signature; Special Purpose Vehicles
materials: Aluminium, steel, glass, leather, plastic; welding, assembling, moulding, painting
partner: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museums)

ar.name: علبة أقلام
description: إن علب الأقلام ذات الحجرات المنفصلة من أجل وضع الأقلام وكل الإكسسوارات الأخرى كانت تستخدم في كل العالم الإسلامي. وقد كانت تصمم بأشكال كثيرة وأغلبها مستطيل الشكل ذو نهايات إما مربعة او دائرية . والنوع المختلف هو الشكل الإسفيني الإيراني الشرقي والمصنوع من جزئين وذو علبة محتواة داخليا التي يمكن إزالتها كليا. وعلب الأقلام هذه ربما كانت توضع في الحزام وهي عادة  استمرت حتى العصور العثمانية.

en.name: Pen box
description: Pen boxes with separate compartments for the *qalam* and all the other accessories were used all over the Islamic world. They were fashioned in numerous shapes, most of which are rectangular with either square or rounded ends. A different type is the East Iranian wedge shape, made in two parts, with an inner, compartmented box that could be entirely removed. These pen boxes were probably pushed through the belt, a fashion which was retained up until Ottoman times.
